title: Media Buyer / Performance Marketer - Meta & Google Ads - (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Valkental GmbH
description_html:
150.000 € Werbebudget pro Woche in der Peakzeit. Und der Plan ist, dass es mehr wird.

Valkental entwickelt seit 2020 Outdoorprodukte für mehr Sicherheit und Komfort im Straßenverkehr. Über 400.000 Kunden vertrauen bereits auf uns. Unser Shop ist achtstellig. Deine Aufgabe ist es, ihn auf dem Weg zu einem neunstelligen zu begleiten.

Unsere Meta- und Google-Accounts steuert bisher einer der Gründer und Geschäftsführer. Jetzt übergibt er sie. Und zwar an dich. Du übernimmst rund 500.000 € Ad-Spend im Monat, in Vollzeit, 100 % remote und mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung. Dein Job: den Account profitabel skalieren.

Aufgaben

Kurzfassung: Du siehst jeden Tag als Erstes, was im Account passiert, und entscheidest, was als Nächstes kommt. Für den Account. Für die Creatives. Für das Wachstum.

  • Du steuerst Meta und Google täglich: Budgets, Struktur (ABO/CBO), Gebotsstrategien, Kill oder Promote.
  • Du skalierst profitabel und findest Wege, mehr Spend bei gleichem NC-ROAS auszugeben.
  • Du fährst Sales-Events wie die Black Week mit sechsstelligem Budget selbst.
  • Du analysierst die Performance in Triple Whale, Meta, Google und Shopify und gibst deine Learnings direkt an unsere Creative Strategists weiter.
  • Du baust unser wöchentliches KPI-Reporting über alle Kanäle auf.
  • Du entwickelst unsere Automationen mit KI-Routinen weiter und testest neue Kanäle.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Media Buying bei einer E-Commerce-Brand oder Performance-Agentur, mit eigener Budgetverantwortung.
  • Meta Ads beherrschst du sicher: Du hast Accounts eigenständig gesteuert und skaliert und weißt, wie Gebotsstrategien, Zielgruppen und Attribution zusammenspielen.
  • Du hast Budgets verantwortet, bei denen ein Fehler weh tut: mindestens fünfstellig im Monat, mindestens ein sechsstelliges Sales-Event.
  • Google Ads (Search, Shopping, PMax) kannst du bereits oder lernst du schnell.
  • Du denkst in Zahlen (Triple Whale oder vergleichbar, MER, Post-Purchase-Survey) und nutzt KI selbstverständlich für Analysen und Automationen.
  • Du arbeitest genau und triffst trotzdem mutige Budgetentscheidungen, wenn es ums Skalieren geht.
  • Du bist bereit, auch am Wochenende zu arbeiten: Der Account wird jeden Tag geprüft. Auch samstags. Auch sonntags.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und gutes Englisch.

Benefits

  • Ein Account, mit dem du wirklich arbeiten kannst: rund 500.000 € Ad-Spend im Monat. Tendenz steigend.
  • Echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du fährst den Account eigenständig.
  • Klare Entwicklungsperspektive: Wer kann und will, wächst bei uns Richtung Senior oder Head of Marketing.
  • Gehalt nach Erfahrung (nach oben offen).
  • 100 % Remote: Du arbeitest von wo du willst, solange du in Europa lebst und erreichbar bist.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Du teilst dir deinen Tag selbst ein, solange der Account täglich gecheckt ist.
  • Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung: Du sprichst mit den Leuten, die entscheiden.
  • Technik-Setup deiner Wahl.
  • Zugang zu Corporate Benefits.
  • Ehrliches, direktes Feedback, das dich schneller weiterbringt.
  • Ein bis zwei Teamevents im Jahr.

Klingt das nach dir? Dann brauchen wir kein Anschreiben. Zeig uns lieber Zahlen: Welche Accounts hast du gesteuert, mit welchen Monatsbudgets und mit welchen Ergebnissen (NC-ROAS, MER, CPA)? Welches Sales-Event hast du selbst gefahren?

Praktisch: Deinen Lebenslauf lädst du unter „CV“ hoch. Alles andere (Zahlen, Screenshots, ein kurzes Wort zu dir) packst du ins Anschreiben-Feld (max. 10 MB).

Wichtig: Bewerbungen ohne konkrete Accounts und Zahlen sortieren wir aus.

Wenn du dir vorher ein Bild von uns machen willst: Auf unserer Karriereseite lernst du das Team kennen.

Tabea und das Valkental-Team freuen sich auf dich!

description_html:
Wir von Gastro-Beratung.de unterstützen Gastronomiebetriebe bei der Digitalisierung - von Kassensystemen über digitale Speisekarten (QR-Codes) bis hin zu Bestell- und Zahlungslösungen. Als Onboarding Manager*in arbeitest du direkt mit unseren Kunden in Hamburg und Umgebung zusammen und hilfst ihnen, die digitale Transformation erfolgreich umzusetzen.

Wir zeigen dir Stück für Stück die besten Systeme auf dem Markt und du entscheidest in welchem du zum Experten für unser Team werden möchtest, damit du mittelfristig selbst Kunden betreuen und Projekte entwickeln kannst.

Wir sind ein kleines aber ambitioniertes und wachsendes Team mit entspannter Arbeitsatmosphäre und der Möglichkeit deine Rolle individuell zu gestalten.

Aufgaben

  • Onboarding-Support: Einführung und Einrichtung von digitalen Gastronomiesystemen (z. B. Kassensysteme, Bestellsysteme, Reservierungstools).
  • Technische Unterstützung: Direkter Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden bei technischen Problemen.
  • Mitarbeiterschulung: Durchführung von Trainings für Gastronomie-Teams zur Nutzung neuer Systeme.
  • Dokumentation: Erstellung von benutzerfreundlichen Anleitungen und FAQs.
  • Optimierung: Feedback sammeln, um Dienstleistungen und Technologien stetig zu verbessern.

Qualifikation

  • IT-Kenntnisse: Ein Informatik-Studium an einer Hochschule oder Universität bzw. ein vergleichbarer Studiengang (Medieninformatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik) sind von großem Vorteil aber nicht zwingend erforderlich.
  • Technisches Interesse: Affinität zu digitalen Lösungen und ihrer praktischen Anwendung.
  • Kenntnisse: Erfahrung mit CSV-Daten, grundlegenden Netzwerk- und Programmierkenntnissen von Vorteil.
  • Kommunikationsstärke: Technische Inhalte verständlich und kundenorientiert vermitteln.
  • Lösungsorientierung: Selbstständige, strukturierte und proaktive Arbeitsweise.
  • Mobilität: Bereitschaft zu Vor-Ort-Terminen im Hamburger Umland (z.B. Hannover od. Harburg) (Führerschein von Vorteil, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich).
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. (Mindestens C2)

Benefits

  • Praxisnahe Einblicke: Mitarbeit an der Digitalisierung von Gastronomiebetrieben in einem wachsenden Markt.
  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten nach deinen Bedürfnissen.
  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben und Kundenkontakt.
  • Vergütung: Faires Monatsgehalt mit Bonusregelung sowie der Möglichkeit der Beteiligung an einem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm (VSOP).

Wenn du Gastronomiebetriebe bei der Einführung moderner Technologien unterstützen und wertvolle Erfahrungen in einem dynamischen Arbeitsumfeld sammeln möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Director, GTM & Revenue Operations
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Carwow
description_html:
THE CARWOW GROUP

Carwow Group is driven by a passion for getting people into cars. But not just any car, the right car. That’s why we are building the go-to destination for car-changing, whether you are looking to buy, sell or lease. Designed to reach drivers everywhere with our trail-blazing portfolio of personality rich automotive brands; Carwow, Auto Express, evo, Driving Electric and Car Buyer.

What started as a simple reviews site, is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. Over 10m customers have used Carwow to help them buy and sell cars since its inception.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia, doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with over 1.1 billion annual views, sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

WHY JOIN US?

We are winners of the prestigious Culture 100 award that recognises the most loved and happiest tech companies to work for! We have just raised $52m in funding led by global venture capital firm Bessemer Venture Partners (an early backer of LinkedIn and Shopify) to accelerate our growth plans!

As pioneers, we’re always driving for new territory and positive change, so our work as a group is never done. Where others see difficulty, it’s our responsibility to see possibility – building new experiences, launching new titles and listening to drivers.

Being a part of Carwow Group means championing drivers and the automotive industry, acting as a disrupter and never being afraid to fail (but learning fast when we do!).

Our team of 600 employees across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal are revolutionising car-changing and we are fast expanding our mission across every single brand and country we operate in, so jump in!


THE ROLE

This is a director role running the operating engine behind our commercial teams. Carwow sells cars in two ways: Sell My Car, where drivers sell their car to dealers, and Get Your Car, where they buy or lease their next one. As Director, GTM & Revenue Operations you own the operating model those commercial teams run on: the go-to-market process, the enablement and quality that get people productive, the systems they work in (Salesforce and the wider commercial tech stack), the analytics that forecast the commercial number, and the programme management that lands cross-functional change. The function covers five areas: GTM Operations, Sales Enablement, Tooling & Platform, Rev-Ops Analytics and Program Management. You report to the VP, Marketplace Operations and sit close to both the numbers and the commercial teams you serve. You make the commercial motion work; the commercial teams own the selling and the relationships.

This is a builder's role as much as a running one. You inherit a team of three (programme management, sales enablement and platform) and a clear mandate to grow the function to what the business needs. Shaping and hiring that team, and making the case for it, is central to the job. The commercial org has recently brought its Sell My Car and Get Your Car teams into a single account-management function serving one dealer network, so you'll run one operating model across both products (a unified Salesforce, aligned targets and comp, consistent enablement and quality) and get the last of that integration to steady state. The function has already moved real numbers here, reworking the sales process, standing up sales-engagement tooling and sharpening enablement, and your job is to take that further.

You own the operating model, process, enablement, the systems requirement and the forecast. The commercial organisation owns the relationships, the selling and delivery against the number. You design the targets, compensation and territory structures with commercial leadership and you shape decisions through the strength of the operating case. In your first year, success looks like a forecast that's trusted and accurate, new hires productive faster, a consistent quality bar across the combined team, and the platform and process the org runs on every day.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

You will own the commercial operating model and the team that runs it, working hand in glove with the commercial organisation, Workforce Management, the trading leads, and the analytics and data teams that support the whole function.

  • Own GTM operations: define the go-to-market playbook, pipeline and commercial process across both marketplaces, and, with commercial leadership, design the targets, compensation and territory / account structures that tie individual attainment to the business outcome. Own capacity and headcount planning with Workforce Management.

  • Own sales enablement and quality: build the onboarding and ramp-to-productivity structures, a standard readiness sign-off, org-wide QA and calibration, and ongoing L&D for both individual contributors and leaders, so new hires get productive faster and quality holds across the organisation.

  • Own the requirements for the commercial systems and tooling: direct Salesforce as the commercial system of record, owning the process and workflow design, prioritisation and the roadmap to bring the whole commercial org onto one platform, plus the sales-engagement and automation tooling (e.g. Groove), AI-assisted workflows and the performance dashboards the teams run on. You own the requirement and how the commercial org runs on the platform; the platform itself, its build and administration, sits with the tech org, who you partner with and direct.

  • Own revenue-operations analytics and forecasting: produce a forward-looking commercial forecast that feeds trading and reconciles to Finance's P&L view, own the operational reporting that diagnoses what the volume and operational teams are driving into the number, and provide the evidence base behind comp and performance decisions. You own the operational read and set the requirement; you partner with Finance and the central analytics and data teams, who own the build.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Working within a team to Contribute to the overall performance by consistently meeting individual targets against vehicles listed & Pipeline conversion.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to provide insights and feedback, contributing to the overall growth and success of Carwow.

 

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • Experience working within a target focused environment and managing a pipeline independently.

description_html:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In the last couple of years we have gone big and acquired both Carwow Leasey, a leasing broker and Autovia, creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines, doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. We also launched our successful Sell My Car business in Germany. We are continually driving to make Carwow the go-to destination for people looking to change their car.



Role Overview

The Business Director will lead the commercial growth and strategic positioning of Moshi, Carwow’s in-house creative agency serving OEM partners.

This is a senior leadership role responsible for driving revenue, owning key OEM relationships and embedding Moshi as a core part of Carwow’s commercial proposition across markets. The role will bridge commercial, creative and production teams to ensure Moshi delivers high-impact, scalable creative solutions that drive measurable value for OEM partners.

The Business Director will also play a critical role in shaping Moshi’s operating model, ensuring the agency is structured for growth with clear processes, strong client service and efficient delivery.

Key Responsibilities

1. Commercial Ownership & Revenue Growth

  • Own Moshi’s revenue performance and growth trajectory across all markets

  • Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities across:

    • Creative campaigns

    • Always-on content

    • Product launches

    • Strategic content partnerships

  • Partner with Carwow commercial leadership to embed Moshi into OEM deals and co-funded activity

  • Drive revenue diversification beyond one-off projects into longer-term, higher-margin partnerships

  • Build clear commercial frameworks (pricing, packaging, margin discipline)

2. OEM Client Leadership

  • Own senior relationships with OEM marketing stakeholders across key accounts

  • Position Moshi as a strategic creative partner, not a production vendor

  • Lead:

    • Brief development

    • Creative solutioning

    • Proposal creation

    • Pitch presentations

  • Translate OEM business objectives into effective creative and content strategies

  • Ensure high levels of client satisfaction, retention and upsell

3. Pipeline Development & Business Development

  • Build and manage a robust Moshi pipeline across all markets

  • Work closely with Carwow commercial teams (UK, Germany, Spain) to:

    • Identify opportunities within existing OEM partnerships

    • Introduce Moshi into early-stage commercial conversations

  • Lead proactive outreach and proposal development

  • Convert:

    • One-off campaigns → repeat engagements

    • Repeat engagements → strategic retainers / partnerships

4. Operational Structure & Delivery Oversight

  • Establish scalable delivery processes to support Moshi growth

  • Improve:

    • Resource planning and utilisation

    • Project workflow and timelines

    • Cross-market coordination

  • Work closely with creative and production teams to:

    • Ensure high-quality output

    • Maintain delivery efficiency

    • Protect margins

  • Introduce clear reporting on project performance (delivery, profitability, client outcomes)

5. Team Leadership & Capability Building

  • Lead and develop Moshi’s client services and delivery teams

  • Define a clear operating structure aligned to growth ambitions

  • Build capability across:

    • Client servicing

    • Commercial thinking

    • Creative strategy

  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on:

    • Accountability

    • Quality

    • Commercial outcomes

Key Success Metrics

  • Moshi revenue growth (YoY and vs target)

  • Contribution to overall Carwow OEM revenue

  • Pipeline value and conversion rates

  • Client retention and expansion (share of wallet)

  • Project profitability and margin improvement

  • Delivery performance (on time, on budget, quality)

Skills & Experience

  • Significant experience in a senior commercial or client leadership role within a creative/media/agency environment

  • Proven track record of driving revenue growth and managing senior client relationships

  • Strong understanding of:

    • Brand and performance marketing

    • Content and creative production

    • Automotive / OEM marketing (preferred)

  • Experience building pipelines, leading pitches and converting strategic partnerships

  • Strong commercial acumen with ability to balance creativity and profitability

  • Experience working across multiple markets and cross-functional teams

Personal Attributes

  • Commercially driven and outcome-focused

  • Credible at senior OEM stakeholder level

  • Strategic thinker with hands-on execution capability

  • Strong communicator and storyteller

  • Able to operate in a fast-paced, scaling environment

  • High ownership mentality with a bias for action

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • 30-minute virtual Introductory call with our Talent team

  • 45-minute virtual Hiring Manager interview

  • Take-home exercise, followed by a 1.5-hour onsite interview

  • Virtual Values interview with key senior stakeholders

 

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Competitive comp package

  • 28 days' holiday plus bank holidays, increasing to 35 with length of service, plus extras for house moves, weddings and more!

  • Employee-friendly share options

  • Pension scheme via Royal London - up to 5% company contribution

  • Vitality private healthcare insurance

  • Life Assurance - 4x annual salary

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, including up to 20 weeks' full pay maternity and shared parental leave, and 8 weeks' full partner pay, as well as fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • 'Work from abroad for a month' annual scheme

  • Generous learning and development budget

  • £500/€550 home office budget

title: Payroll Implementation Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Sona
description_html:
Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

 

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.

 

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

 

About the Role

 

As a Payroll Implementation Manager at Sona, you'll take end-to-end ownership of onboarding customers onto our payroll platform, from initial discovery and system configuration through to parallel runs, training, and go-live.

You'll work hands-on with the software itself, not just alongside it, partnering closely with the wider implementation team, product engineers, and payroll bureau colleagues to get every customer live cleanly. Attention to detail and end-to-end ownership matter more here than in most roles, and you'll need to be comfortable double-checking your own work and speaking up early when something doesn't look right.

This role sits within a growing customer function that's still finding its shape. You'll have direct influence over how Sona's payroll implementation process and product evolve, with a level of access to the product team that's unusual for an implementer. It's a startup pace: no bureaucracy, high-caliber colleagues, and fast-moving development, so you'll need to be comfortable operating without everything being fully defined.

 

Responsibilities

 

  • Own end-to-end payroll implementations: discovery, system configuration, parallel runs, training, and go-live

  • Configure and troubleshoot UK payroll setups, including GL and pensions configuration and RTI processing

  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and take ownership of seeing them through

  • Partner with Project Managers and Solutions Architects to support the wider implementation journey

  • Provide ad hoc on-site customer support for training and launch, alongside remote delivery

  • Use AI tools confidently in your day to day work, from reconciliation to communication

 

Requirements

 

  • Proven, hands-on experience implementing UK payroll systems end-to-end, not just coordinating others who do

  • Deep working knowledge of UK payroll legislation and processing

  • Genuinely curious, adaptable, and comfortable with ambiguity - things won't always be fully defined

  • High attention to detail and a strong sense of accountability

  • Comfortable using AI in everyday tools like spreadsheets, communications, and reconciliation

  • Bonus: CIPP (or equivalent) qualification, or working towards one

 

Benefits

 

  • Salary: £50,000 - £60,000

  • London, hybrid - 2 days a week in the office, with occasional travel to customer sites for training and launch support

  • Share options

  • 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days)

  • Extra day of leave for every year of service

  • Pension contributions matched up to 5%

  • Comprehensive health insurance

  • Enhanced parental leave & pay

  • Workplace nursery salary sacrifice scheme

  • Annual all expenses paid team retreats

  • The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office

  • Professional development budget

  • Unlimited free books


Note: this represents a typical benefits package for a UK-based, full-time employee. Exact details may vary based on location and employment type but we try to be as fair as possible to all of our team members. Please ask your contact in the Talent team to clarify the available benefits for you.

 

Compensation: £50K – £60K • Offers Equity

title: Business Development Representative (BDR) – UK
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Dandy
description_html:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role

We’re building out our first UK BDR team to generate leads and fill the top of our sales funnel as we launch the go-to-market function from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity to shape the sales function in a hyper-growth environment and work closely with senior leadership to drive revenue and impact. This role will support both inbound and outbound sales motions — engaging with dental practices who express interest in Dandy while also proactively generating new opportunities through outbound prospecting.

What You’ll Do

  • Be the first point of contact for a wide range of dental practice prospects.

  • Generate new business through outbound channels including email, phone, and creative outreach tactics.

  • Track sales activity using Salesforce and other tools, and continuously improve your processes.

  • Pitch the Dandy value proposition, handle objections, and move prospects through the funnel.

  • Collaborate closely with Account Executives for seamless client handoffs.

  • Contribute ideas to build the UK BDR function from scratch — your feedback will shape our processes, tools, and strategy.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of professional sales experience in a high-growth environment

  • Experience with cold calling (SMB targets are a big plus)

  • Commitment to continuous improvement and desire to learn new sales concepts via rigorous trainings

  • Ability to punch through ambiguity and ramp up quickly

  • Experience with standard sales tools and a desire to explore and implement new tools to further streamline the sales process

  • Overall track record of professional and academic success

  • With the above stated, we are open to candidates of all backgrounds and encourage you to apply if interested!

Bonus Points For

  • Outstanding professional references to share

  • Experience with marketplace models

  • Love of blitz growth environments

  • Relentlessly positive attitude, strong sense of humor, and the ability to have fun at work

Compensation

  • £50,000 Base, £19,444 Bonus + Equity.

Job ID: J-821

Dandy is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

If you require any accommodations for your interview or have any questions beforehand, rest assured that we will do everything we can to meet your needs. Visit Dandy Careers for more!

title: Senior Account Executive
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Aurorasolar
description_html:
About Aurora Solar

Aurora is on a mission to create a future of solar for all. Our award-winning software puts the power of data and technology into the hands of every solar professional to make solar adoption simple and predictable. Our software has designed millions of solar projects so far, empowering solar companies to sell, design, and install residential and commercial solar arrays accurately, seamlessly, and at scale. 


We’ve been named one of "The Best Remote Companies" by BuiltIn.com and have been recognized for the second time as a Certified Green Business (CGB) with the city of San Francisco. We’re in this together to support the world’s transition to solar.

About the Team

Aurora Solar’s European sales team is helping build the company's commercial presence across Europe. We're a collaborative, ambitious group that works closely together, moves with purpose, and is committed to delivering meaningful results for our customers. United by a belief in solar's role in Europe's energy future, we partner across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Account Management and Leadership to help customers succeed. In this role, you'll have the support and resources needed to thrive while taking ownership of driving new business growth and delivering against your goals.

About the Role

In this role, you'll drive new business growth across core markets, Germany, France and the UK in addition to Italy, Austria, Belgium, Ireland, Spain and Portugal. Helping solar installers, EPCs, and energy companies modernize how they sell, design, and deliver solar projects. You'll lead the full sales cycle—from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close—partnering closely with customers to understand their goals and demonstrate how Aurora can help them operate more efficiently and scale their businesses. Working alongside Solutions Engineering, you'll deliver tailored solutions that address market-specific needs and create measurable value for customers.

As part of a growing European team, you'll also help shape Aurora's presence in key markets across the region. Your customer insights, market feedback, and competitive observations will influence go-to-market strategy, inform product direction, and help establish the playbook for continued growth in Europe.

This position is hybrid from London, UK.

Your Impact

  • Own and exceed a quarterly and annual ARR quota targeting solar installers, EPCs, and energy companies throughout Europe

  • Lead full-cycle new business opportunities from prospecting through close, including, discovery, solution positioning, stakeholder alignment, negotiation, and close

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through outbound prospecting, inbound demand, and partner-sourced leads

  • Conduct structured discovery conversations that connect customer challenges to measurable business outcome across sales efficiency, design accuracy, and regulatory compliance workflows

  • Partner with Solutions Engineering to deliver tailored product demonstrations and solution proposals for European customers.

  • Maintain accurate pipeline visibility and forecasting within Salesforce to support business planning and revenue predictability.

  • Share market, customer, and competitive insights with Product, Marketing, and EU leadership to help inform roadmap and go-to-market strategy

  • Represent Aurora at industry events, conferences and trade shows across Europe

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of full-cycle, quota-carrying B2B sales experience, with a proven track record of outperforming revenue goals through consultative selling (SaaS/tech experience preferred).

  • Experience managing multi-stakeholder sales cycles from prospecting through to close

  • Ability to lead a consultative sales motion by uncovering customer challenges, understanding business priorities, and connect solutions to measurable outcomesExperience presenting solutions and proposals to operations, financial, and executive stakeholders.

  • Experience using CRM systems to manage pipeline and forecast revenue

Nice to Haves

  • Experience selling into the solar, renewable energy, energy technology, construction technology, or field service software industries.

  • Genuine interest in renewable energy and solar's role in the European energy transition

  • Experience in a high-growth company or expanding into new markets

  • Familiarity with value-based sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC.

  • Salesforce experience

Benefits: We strive to be the best place for the best people, and that includes the benefits and perks we offer. We provide a holistic program to support physical, emotional, financial, and social needs. This includes work-from-home stipends for home office setup, internet, and co-working spaces. Service providers will receive flexible paid time off including statutory vacation and sick leave, with additional parental leave available. Service providers receive a standard laptop and an annual healthcare budget through AXA. Service providers will also receive perks including access to Wellhub for comprehensive well-being support and Modern Health for mental health resources.


Where Aurorans are: Aurora currently has teams within the US, Canada, Poland, and Germany with additional locations on the horizon. We’re united in our work to support the world’s transition to solar!

Aurora is dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workforce of people who believe in and are passionate about creating a future of solar energy for all. We are an equal opportunity employer, we welcome and consider qualified applicants regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. We encourage you to apply even if you believe that you do not meet all of the above criteria!

Aurora is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation that would better enable your success during the application or interview process, please complete this form.

Compensation: £78,100 – £105,700 • Offers Equity • £73,520 Commission

  • London, UK • £78,100 – £105,700 • Offers Equity • £73,520 Commission

title: Implementation Manager I - UK & Nordics
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Mollie
description_html:
Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

You'll own the post-sales integration phase for Mollie's largest and most complex deals, taking full responsibility from contract signature through go-live and the handover that follows. That means acting as the central point of contact for the merchant and every internal Mollie team involved, setting out the activities, owners, and timelines needed to get each implementation live.

You'll coordinate closely with sales, sales engineering, onboarding, compliance, product, and other teams to resolve issues as they come up, using your technical understanding to assess merchant problems, work through documentation, and route issues to the right place. You'll keep merchants, digital agencies, and internal stakeholders informed with regular updates, and you'll monitor progress against the agreed go-live date so you can act early when timelines are at risk.

This is a newly formed function that's now expanding into new markets. That means you'll have genuine influence over how the role and its processes take shape, working closely with a flat, collaborative team where good practice is shared regardless of hierarchy.

What you'll ship

  • Own the post sales integration phase for Mollie's largest and most complex deals, from handover through testing to go live

  • Run kickoffs with internal and external stakeholders, setting go live dates and keeping progress on track

  • Organise and track testing, raising issues and feedback as they surface

  • Coordinate across sales, product and engineering colleagues, as well as with merchants directly, to keep everyone aligned

  • Keep agreed go live dates on track, since delays mean missed revenue

  • Maintain documentation and playbooks that make delivery predictable and scalable

What you'll bring

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in implementation, project management, onboarding, delivery, or a similar customer-facing role.

  • Experience in payments, fintech, e-commerce is a plus

  • Proven experience managing complex implementations from contract signature through go-live and handover.

  • Solid understanding of APIs, integrations and technical documentation, with the ability to investigate implementation issues and work with technical teams.

  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, including managing timelines, blockers, dependencies and multiple internal and external stakeholders.

  • Structured, proactive and pragmatic approach, with strong ownership and the confidence to challenge when needed.

  • Excellent communication skills in English

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

 

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

 

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

title: Sales Executive (Portuguese Speaking)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Siteminder
description_html:
At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.

What we do...

Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.

That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.

About the Sales Executive (Portuguese Speaking) role...

You will be working with hotel owners across a number of territories in Africa and the UK, building awareness about how our products can benefit their property. You will have the chance to learn about the challenges that accommodation providers face, and offer a solution that will bring value to their day-to-day and bottom line. Joining SiteMinder as the leader in dynamic hotel revenue management, you will be at the forefront of innovation in the sector. 

We won't throw you into the deep end - you'll be trained on our products, industry and sales processes. We have a month-long sales training and onboarding program to make sure you are set up for success. You will be supported by a dedicated sales coach and a buddy, as well as your team leader, who will coach and motivate you to achieve your professional goals.

What you'll do:

  • Client acquisition - Creating new opportunities and upselling current customers. 

  • Achieving sales KPIs and targets - finalizing all sales in a timely manner. Identify upgrade opportunities with existing client base and generate new sales from these organisations. 

  • Presentation and negotiation – Prepare accurate quotes and develop and present proposals to clients in a professional and confident manner. Negotiate contracts as required, maintaining a balance between optimal service and value for the client and SiteMinder's profit margins. 

  • CRM maintenance – Maintain accurate records of your business development activities on SiteMinder's CRM system. Ensure all documentation is complete post sales to set up trials and to move the client to a subscription. 

  • Client feedback – Provide client feedback on products to the Product Team so that products can be reviewed in line with the feedback. 

What we need from you:

  • Minimum 12 months of Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) sales experience

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and spoken)

  • A confident phone presence, fearlessness in leading meetings with prospects, and great listening skills 

  • Strong verbal skills to communicate professionally with customers, in writing and over the phone 

  • Self-motivation and resilience to show up each day and give your best 

  • Growth mindset - openness to feedback and coaching

Our Perks & Benefits…

  • Equity packages for you to be a part of the SiteMinder journey 

  • Hybrid working model (3 days per week at our London Hammersmith office)

  • Mental health and well-being initiatives

  • Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy

  • Paid birthday, study and volunteering leave every year

  • Sponsored social clubs, team events, and celebrations

  • Employee Resource Groups (ERG) to help you connect and get involved 

  • Investment in your personal growth offering training for your advancement

Think this role sounds like you? If so, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your resume and our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.

 

When you apply, feel free to share your pronouns and let us know if you need any adjustments during the interview process, we’re here to support you. We also warmly encourage applications from people from underrepresented backgrounds.

title: Staff Product Designer | JetBrains

description_html:
About JetBrains Air

JetBrains has been building developer tools since 2000 — including IntelliJ IDEA, Kotlin, TeamCity, and more, now trusted by 15M+ developers at 287K companies worldwide. The company is 100% private, profitable, and driven by a single thesis: great tools make developers better.

Air is what JetBrains is building next: an agentic development environment where multiple AI agents run tasks in parallel while the developer stays in control. It’s a genuinely new kind of developer tool — spanning a native desktop app, an expanding web experience, and cloud-based automations. It’s the next frontier after IDEs: not just helping developers write code, but helping them orchestrate it.

The Air design team is two people now — and you’d be the third. Your primary focus will be the web surface and the automations sub-team: an emerging part of the product that is ready for dedicated design ownership, with a real opportunity to raise the bar and shape the experience from the ground up.

What you’ll be working on

  • Design the web interface for Air: team management, automation setup, and a results overview

  • Shape the design process for the automations sub-team, working directly with developers to establish review and handoff practices

  • You decide what gets built. You turn a vague product direction into scope, a plan and a shipped surface, and you say no to the rest.

  • Own how the design system evolves across web and desktop: what belongs in it, what stays local, how two surfaces stay one product.

  • Vibe-code and use AI for prototyping when it helps move ideas forward faster

  • Participate in cross-team demos and quarterly planning, bringing a design perspective to where Air should go next

What you need

  • 7+ years of product design experience, with great examples of delivering results that impact the business.

  • Ownership instinct. You see features through from design to production. Delivery is part of your definition of done.

  • Excellent cross-team project delivery. You can work with limited context, clarify what matters, define the scope, and move projects forward across teams without needing constant hand-holding.

  • Active AI user. You use AI tools in your design workflow. You’ve experimented with building or prototyping with Cursor, Claude, or similar. This market moves weekly; you should too.

  • Solid Figma skills. Proficient with components, tokens/variables, and design systems — you can navigate an existing UI kit, understand how it works, and contribute new components as the product grows.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with developer-focused products or technical tooling (IDEs, dashboards, data tools)

  • Experience with vibe-coding, design engineering, or code-level prototypes

  • Familiarity with agentic or AI-native interface patterns — trust signals, human-in-the-loop, error handling at scale

What you get

  • Rare product scope. Work on a product that could define the next generation of developer tooling — small team, direct impact, decisions that ship fast.

  • JetBrains’ culture. Engineering-first, quality-focused, 100% private. No VC pressure, no artificial growth targets.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits — location-dependent, with a full breakdown available on request.

title: Founding AE - UK
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Nebuly
description_html:
Location: London – hybrid

Type: Full-time

Level: Senior

Compensation: £160-200k OTE, 50/50 base variable + equity.


About Nebuly

Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI.

 

Every enterprise function — sales, customer support, HR, finance — is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working? Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. The signal that could answer it is right there — millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents — but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer — is this working, and where — and connects the dots back to ROI. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value — with no data ever leaving your environment.

 

Every new data category has created a new software category. CRM turned customer interactions into pipeline accountability. Product analytics turned user behavior into growth accountability. Nebuly is building that same layer for AI — turning millions of invisible conversations into a clear answer on value.

 

Our customers include Oura, CNH Industrial, Vodafone, and Moncler. Demand is accelerating fast, and we're building the team to match.

Your Role

We have a product that works, customers that prove it, and a market that is moving fast. The UK is one of the core regions we are pushing alongside the US, DACH, and Italy — it is not an experiment, it is a strategic priority. In the UK we have early presence but huge white space. No one owns this market yet - not us, not a competitor. The person who takes this role has the opportunity to build a book of business from scratch in a category that every large enterprise will need to buy into over the next three years.

If you have spent the last decade building the right relationships in the UK and you are ready to put them to work in a market that is genuinely early, this is your moment. You will report directly to the Co-founder, have a sales engineer to handle technical discovery, and a channel person alongside you to build the partner ecosystem. Your job is to generate pipeline, navigate deals, and close.

No VP of Sales between you and the decision maker. No committee to approve your approach. Just a big market, a working product, and room to run.

What You’ll Do

  • Generate pipeline fast - primarily through your existing network. There is no inbound engine, no SDR handing you leads. You eat what you kill.

  • Own the full sales cycle end to end: sourcing → pilot → business case → negotiation → close

  • Target mid-market and enterprise accounts with €100K+ ACV potential, navigating multi-stakeholder deals across product, AI, IT, legal, and procurement

  • Be the face of Nebuly in the UK - at events, in conversations, in the market

Who You Are

  • 6+ years of enterprise or mid-market B2B SaaS sales experience in the UK

  • Proven track record of closing multiple 6-figure enterprise contracts

  • Active network of prospects and decision-makers in the the UK enterprise space

  • Comfortable in technical sales conversations (with CTOs, ML teams, data leads)

  • You know how to win deals without inbound or SDRs - you drive your own pipeline

  • Experience working alongside system integrators and advisory firms - you know how to bring them into a deal, co-sell with them, and build the relationship that eventually generates referrals.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, a lean process, and building as you go

  • Fluent in English

You do not need to have sold AI observability or conversational analytics before. You need to know the buyers and know how to sell.

Bonus Points

  • Experience as a first sales hire or market launcher

  • Background in data, analytics, ML infrastructure, or developer tools

What We Offer

A product with proof. You have a working product, enterprise logos, and a category narrative that resonates with exactly the buyers you will be calling.

Real earning potential. £160-200k OTE, 50/50 base variable. Compensation is flexible based on experience and fit.

Equity. You are early. That means something.

No bureaucracy. You will report directly to the Co-founder and have a sales engineer to handle technical discovery, and field marketing support to help with events. You will start by selling directly - but as you build the first logos in the UK, activating the first partner relationships is part of the job too. A dedicated Partnerships Manager joins once the market has validated. Until then, the partner motion is yours.


Sound like you? Apply now. We'd love to meet you.

title: Data Analytics Senior Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Flagstone
description_html:
What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.

A feel for our culture:

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.

Does this sound like you?

You're a senior data leader who has taken a data function through genuine transformation, and who is as comfortable presenting to a CEO as you are defending a methodology to a peer. You understand what a high performing function looks like, you know how to build toward it, and you have the credibility and composure to hold your ground when the data tells a story that senior stakeholders don't want to hear.

What you'll do

You'll play a key role in shifting the function from a service that reports what has happened to one that drives decisions about what should happen next. You'll work closely with the Head of Data to lay the foundations for a more strategic, consultative model, building the team, the tools, and the ways of working that will continue to move Flagstone from reactive reporting to predictive, commercially driven insights.

This will include:

  • Setting the analytics roadmap, prioritising and sequencing delivery so the function is focused on the work that will have the greatest commercial impact

  • Setting a clear direction for establishing and growing data science capability within the function, systematically reducing low value activity to create the capacity to get there

  • Driving measurable adoption of self serve analytics across Growth, Engagement, Partnerships and beyond. This isn't about publishing dashboards, it's about training, supporting, and tracking uptake so ad hoc request volume falls and teams own their own insights.

  • Rebalancing delivery accountability that currently sits too heavily with analytics, working with tribe leads through sustained and active escalation to shift ownership back to them

  • Leading and line managing Data Analysts and Senior Data Analysts, setting clear expectations for quality, delivery, and behaviour, and acting as the escalation point for analytical disputes, ambiguity, or risk

  • Leading from the front on modern tooling and applied data science methods, and building the team's capability through coaching, pairing, and structured development.

  • Helping analysts understand how their role is evolving, encouraging the team to move from responding to requests to proactively identifying opportunities and influencing decisions.

  • Operating as a credible authority with C Suite level stakeholders, with the composure and evidence to challenge assumptions, and clearly articulate what the data does and does not support

  • Defending analytical methodology under scrutiny, clearly articulating why a model or approach was chosen over alternatives and what could undermine it

  • Exercising independent judgement on when an insight is significant enough to escalate and when it can wait, taking accountability for the downstream business impact of analytical outputs, not just their technical correctness

  • Owning the most complex and high impact analytical work, including methodology selection, assumptions, and interpretation.

  • Ensuring all outputs are trusted, contextualised, reproducible, and aligned with governance expectations before informing decisions.

What you'll bring

  • Significant experience in data analytics, including ownership of high stakes analysis and operation as a hybrid IC / manager.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage C Suite level stakeholders, with the gravitas and credibility to influence at the most senior levels and the confidence to challenge when the data demands it

  • Proven track record of landing self serve adoption where you've led a team through this shift before. You can point to measurable outcomes e.g. falling ad hoc volume, teams confidently self-serving, sustained change.

  • Experience rebalancing accountability in matrixed environments. You've worked in cross functional organisations where product/tribe leadership needed to own their data insights. You know how to escalate, how to hold boundaries, and how to make the shift stick.

  • Experience in building partnerships across functions, not just within your team or your immediate leadership chain, but with tribe leads, product managers, and operational teams. You've driven adoption of your team's work.

  • Strong hands on technical capability, including SQL, Power BI, and Python or similar. You build capability by doing, not just directing.

  • Communication and conviction, with the ability to operate credibly with senior stakeholders and hold the line on quality and ways of working when it matters.

How we reward you:

At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits:

  • Hybrid working - Spend at least 1 day a week with your team in our collaborative London office

  • Competitive bonus scheme - designed to reward and recognise high performance

  • Flexible benefits budget - a pot to fund meaningful benefits for you, whether it's hormone or fertility testing, cancer screening, neuro-diversity coaching or something that matters for you.

  • A range of salary sacrifice options to help you make tax efficient savings on electric cars, nursery schemes, home and tech goods.

  • Working Abroad - Flagstone employees can work remotely from an approved list of locations for up to 90 days a year

  • Mental wellbeing support – Access therapy and mental health sessions through Spill

  • Learning and development – £1,000 personal development budget to help you grow in your role.

  • Private health care - Enjoy all the benefits AXA has to offer, including reduced gym memberships and medical history disregarded

  • Medical cash plan - To help you with the costs of dental and optical expenses

  • Life insurance and Income Protection- four times your annual salary for peace of mind

  • Matched pension contributions up to 5%

  • 25 days holiday - plus bank holidays, well-being days and volunteering days

  • Enhanced Parental Leave – enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay.

All are welcome.

At Flagstone, we’re assembling a diverse team that defies our industry’s norms. Think this role could suit you? We encourage you to apply, no matter your background.

title: Controller (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Gunia Consulting
description_html:
Ein Recycling Scaleup im Raum Düsseldorf sucht seinen ersten Controller.

Bisher gibt es kein Controlling. Diese Rolle baut die Funktion von Grund auf und berichtet direkt an die Geschäftsführung. Kein fünfter Controller im Konzern, sondern die wirtschaftliche Stimme direkt gegenüber der Geschäftsführung.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Monatsabschlüsse, Budgets und Forecasts erstellen, als Entscheidungsgrundlage für die Geschäftsführung, nicht als Excel-Übung.
  • Kostenstellenrechnung aufbauen und Deckungsbeitragsanalysen durchführen.
  • Liquidität und Working Capital steuern, Finanzierungsinstrumente koordinieren.
  • Aussagekräftige Kennzahlen und Dashboards entwickeln, die tatsächlich genutzt werden.
  • Repetitive Finance-Prozesse gemeinsam mit der IT automatisieren.
  • Die Buchhaltung bei Abwesenheit vertreten (vorbereitende Buchhaltung).

Qualifikation

Dein Profil:

  • Mindestens 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung im Controlling, idealerweise in einem operativ geprägten Umfeld (Logistik, Handel, Industrie oder Produktion).
  • Sicher in Budgetplanung, Forecasting, Kostenstellen- und Deckungsbeitragsrechnung.
  • Erfahrung in der vorbereitenden Buchhaltung.
  • Excel auf fortgeschrittenem Niveau, DATEV und EasyBill von Vorteil, BI- oder KI-gestütztes Reporting ein Plus.
  • Strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich, auch wenn mehrere Themen parallel laufen.
  • Klartext gegenüber dem Management, auch wenn es unbequem wird.
  • Hands-on Mentalität. Wir suchen Leute, die ihre Ärmel hochkrempeln und anpacken.
  • Fließendes Deutsch, gutes Englisch von Vorteil.

Benefits

Das erwartet dich:

  • Gestaltungsfreiheit: du baust das Controlling aktiv mit auf, keine starren Strukturen.
  • Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung, kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen.
  • Hybrides Arbeiten: mindestens 2 Präsenztage in Neuss, der Rest flexibel.
  • Moderne Tools und der Freiraum, Finance-Prozesse zu automatisieren.
  • Internationales Team, ohne Konzernbürokratie.
  • Konditionen besprechen wir direkt im Gespräch.

Über das Unternehmen:

Ein Recycling Scaleup im Raum Düsseldorf, seit der Gründung 2020 auf Wachstumskurs. Aus Vertraulichkeit wird der Name erst im ersten Gespräch genannt.

title: Payments Product Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Precoro Inc
description_html:
Precoro is an innovative AI-powered procurement centralization & automation platform, helping companies eliminate manual tasks and control purchasing activities across all subsidiaries. With over 1,000 customers in more than 80 countries, Precoro has proven its ability to create real business value and deliver substantial cost savings.

Over the past 10 years, we have:

  • Gathered 100+ the best  specialists on our team

  • Launched 10 large-scale integrations (including with Amazon, Slack, and Google)

  • Helped 1000+ clients improve purchasing operations

We're looking for a proactive, hands-on Payments Product Manager with a track record of owning payment integrations end-to-end.


You'll take full ownership of how Precoro connects to payment providers and processes transactions, making sure the payment layer scales reliably across our customers in 80+ countries.

This role comes with real autonomy: room to bring your own ideas, drive the direction, and the resources to make it happen - without micromanagement or endless approval chains.

What you'll do

  • Own the Payments product area end-to-end - from discovery and requirements through delivery, launch, and post-launch iteration

  • Understand customer payment workflows across our global client base and translate them into a prioritized, ROI-driven roadmap

  • Create and maintain integrations with payment providers, ensuring reliability, security, and compliance across markets

  • Coordinate across Engineering, CS, Marketing, Sales, and external payment partners to keep the product ready for new markets and payment methods

  • Define and track success metrics, using data to identify friction points and measure impact on adoption and revenue

  • Lead your cross-functional team, setting a standard for clear documentation, sharp prioritization, and shipping with quality

What we look for

  • Hands-on experience building or scaling payment integrations from scratch (routing, PSP/acquirer integrations, virtual cards, ACH, or cross-border payments) 

  • 3-5+ years as a Product Manager, with a track record of shipping features end-to-end

  • Strong ability to work with APIs and technical integrations, including the messy parts: partner limitations, versioning, error handling, reconciliation

  • Critical thinking and comfort navigating ambiguous, multi-layered problems with no obvious shortcuts

  • Outstanding skills in stakeholder management - you can align internal teams, and external partners around a shared roadmap

  • Experience working with data to inform decisions - comfortable writing SQL queries or using BI tools (Power BI/Tableau/Looker) for KPI analysis

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience with B2B SaaS or API-first product development

  • Familiarity with using AI tools as part of your day-to-day product workflow

Why you'll love working at Precoro

  • Trust-based management: No micromanagement - your ideas and initiatives are always encouraged.

  • Supportive team culture: You're not alone, our team is open, honest, and always ready to help.

  • Reimbursement for professional learning: We invest in your growth through courses, lectures, and more.

  • Flexible hours: We care about results, not how long you sit at your desk.

  • 26 days off annually: Work-life balance is a priority for us.

  • Medical insurance and unlimited sick leave without requiring a medical certificate. Your health matters most.

Hiring Process

Our hiring is quick and straightforward:

  • Recruiter interview (45 minutes)

  • Interview with a manager (1 hour)

  • Test task

  • Test task presentation with the team (1 hour)

We foster an environment where everyone is encouraged to contribute ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive business growth!

title: Field Solutions Engineer (5774)

description_html:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Shield AI is hiring a Field Solutions Engineer, Hivemind based in London, United Kingdom to support technical sales, customer engagements, demonstrations, and capture activities for Hivemind, Shield AI’s autonomy solution for intelligent, mission-capable unmanned systems.

Hivemind enables autonomous operation across complex mission environments, allowing aircraft and other robotic systems to perceive, decide, coordinate, and execute with reduced operator burden. This role will serve as a customer-facing technical expert for Hivemind, helping defense and security customers understand how autonomy can solve operational problems, improve mission outcomes, and integrate into existing and future force structures.

This role will focus on supporting customer engagements across the EURAF region, including Europe, the United Kingdom, NATO, African defense and security markets, and allied partner nations. The ideal candidate will bring experience working with international defense, security, aerospace, government, or advanced technology customers and will understand how to navigate varied regional operational priorities, stakeholder dynamics, partner ecosystems, and acquisition environments.

The Field Solutions Engineer will translate customer mission needs, CONOPs, operational constraints, and platform integration considerations into credible, technically feasible Hivemind solution concepts. This includes supporting customer discovery, technical briefings, demonstrations, RFIs, RFPs, white papers, technical interchange meetings, and customer-specific solution development.

Success requires technical credibility, strong communication, product truth, regional awareness, and the ability to connect Hivemind’s autonomy capabilities to real customer missions across varied international operational environments.


What you'll do:

description_html:
Teamleiter Key Account Management (m/w/d)

Standort: Düsseldorf | Vollzeit | Führung & Vertrieb

Über uns

Die Lippe Personal GmbH ist eine der führenden Agenturen im Bereich Recruiting für Arzt- und Zahnarztpraxen im DACH-Raum. Wir helfen unseren Kunden nicht nur, qualifizierte Mitarbeiter zu gewinnen, sondern auch ihre Arbeitgebermarke zu stärken und langfristig erfolgreich zu wachsen.
Um unsere Bestandskundenbetreuung und den Vertrieb auf das nächste Level zu heben, suchen wir dich als Teamleiter Key Account Management (m/w/d).

Deine Aufgaben

  • Führung & Coaching: Leitung eines Teams aus Kundenberatern und Closern, Förderung von Performance, Motivation und Weiterentwicklung.

  • Kundenbindung & Wachstum: Verantwortung für die Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Bestandskunden, Sicherung und Steigerung des Customer Lifetime Value.

  • Umsatzsteigerung: Identifikation und Umsetzung von Upsell-Potenzialen, Steigerung der Vertragsverlängerungen und Generierung von Weiterempfehlungen.

  • Strategie & Prozesse: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung beim Aufbau skalierbarer Vertriebsprozesse und Strukturen.

  • Key Accounts: Persönliche Verantwortung für ausgewählte Schlüsselkunden, Sicherstellung exzellenter Ergebnisse und langfristiger Partnerschaften.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Attraktive Vergütung: 55.000 und 85.000 € brutto/Jahr inkl. Bonusmodell basierend auf Team- und Kundenergebnissen.

  • Verantwortung & Gestaltungsspielraum: Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung beim Aufbau neuer Prozesse und Wachstumsstrategien.

  • Karriereperspektive: Mitwirkung beim Ausbau von Lippe Personal – inkl. langfristiger Perspektive beim Aufbau einer neuen Plattform für medizinisches Recruiting.

  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Neues Büro in Düsseldorf, MacBook, iPhone & moderne Ausstattung.

  • Kultur: Junges, dynamisches Team, flache Hierarchien, regelmäßige Team-Events und ein starkes Wir-Gefühl.

Warum Lippe Personal?

  • Wir sind Marktführer im medizinischen Recruiting – mit einem dynamisch wachsenden Kundenstamm.

  • Bei uns verbindest du strategisches Arbeiten mit operativer Verantwortung.

salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Contabo
description_html:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Senior Platform & Reliability Engineer (all genders) to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).


As a Senior Platform & Reliability Engineer at Contabo, you take architectural ownership of our shared infrastructure services – the foundation that multiple development teams build on: API gateway and ingress (Kong, Nginx Ingress), persistent storage (Ceph, Longhorn), secrets and identity infrastructure (Vault, Keycloak), edge security and WAF (Cloudflare), and our observability stack. You'll be taking over grown, partially under-documented systems – and that's exactly where the appeal of this role lies: you work your way deep into these systems, identify and remediate known weak points, evaluate aging components with solution-agnostic build-vs-buy reasoning, and decide which legacy pieces get fixed, replaced, or retired.

One of your central mandates: you design and establish an on-call process, including runbooks for platform and infrastructure incidents – where no formal process exists today. In parallel, you mature our observability practices, rolling out distributed tracing, SLOs/SLIs, and meaningful dashboards across the stack, building on our existing tooling with Prometheus, Grafana, Alloy, and OpenTelemetry. In system design reviews, you bring your strong grounding in the fundamentals – load balancing, caching, sharding, replication, consistency trade-offs – and apply them to new and existing services alike.

You won't be managing a team, but you will be the technical authority multiple teams rely on: you advise across teams on shared infrastructure services, document your knowledge consistently, and actively distribute it – so that critical know-how never again depends on a single person. Success in this role means: known risks are resolved, a solid on-call process is up and running, and single points of failure are measurably reduced platform-wide. The position is remote (Germany), with hybrid or on-site work optional; occasional travel for datacenter visits and team offsites is part of the role.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with: 

  • 7+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, or SRE roles, ideally with end-to-end responsibility for a private cloud or IaaS platform 
  • Hands-on production experience with distributed storage systems (Ceph) and Kubernetes persistent storage (Longhorn or comparable) 
  • Experience operating API gateways and ingress (Kong, Nginx Ingress, or comparable), including debugging cross-cutting concerns like CORS and rate limiting 
  • Experience with CDN/edge security, DDoS mitigation, and WAF configuration (e.g. Cloudflare), as well as firewall-rule design 
  • A strong grounding in system design fundamentals (load balancing, caching, sharding/replication, consistency models, message queues) – and the judgment to apply them to real-world trade-offs 
  • Experience designing or maturing observability (tracing, metrics, SLOs/SLIs) with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry is desirable 
  • Experience with secrets/identity infrastructure (Vault, Keycloak), messaging systems (NATS), and building on-call processes and incident runbooks from scratch is a plus

Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Senior Cloud Product Manager (all genders) to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first (within Germany), but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).


As a Senior Cloud Product Manager at Contabo, you're stepping into a role that doesn't come around often: you help build a new product from the ground up – a greenfield venture inside an established company, expanding our portfolio into a new market segment. You are the voice of the market and our customers: you establish feedback channels with customer and support teams, translate market and customer needs into a compelling product vision, and take end-to-end ownership of the product roadmap – from high-level planning through prioritisation to delivery, in close alignment with our PMO.

You work in a small, focused team of experts where speed matters: build fast, test fast, learn fast – with AI tools firmly embedded in our daily work, enabling the pace a venture like this demands. You refine ideas until the development teams can implement them with confidence, sequence roadmap items for maximum impact, and shape the best possible user experience together with your UX tandem partner. You don't shy away from technical discussions – you seek them out: you understand the product architecture across the full stack and keep asking "why" until even hidden blockers are on the table – and resolved quickly.

Because the product is new but the company isn't, you hook into existing processes – in finance and infrastructure, for example – and build new ones where gaps remain. You present progress and updates to stakeholders across development, sales, support, marketing, and leadership, acting as their central point of contact. In the medium term, you establish a product-driven roadmap spanning at least two years, along with KPIs that make the platform's success measurable. The role is built for a high degree of autonomy: you report directly to the Head of Product and work independently, driven by results – with no micromanagement, in either direction.


What convinces us
