description_html:
To learn the Hiring Ranges for this position, please select your location from the Apply Now dropdown menu.

To learn more about our Hiring Range System, please click this link.

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

In the past few years, Marketing has emerged as a key vector and focus of Firefox’s growth, with Data Science playing an essential role in evaluating Marketing’s impact and developing clear strategies to ensure that success. Marketing Data Science supports Firefox through the standard fare of marketing (ongoing measurement, experimentation/lift testing, adhoc analysis, forecasting/budget optimization), and beyond that as thought leaders at Firefox in translating broad goals into clearly defined objectives and identifying the path towards succeeding in them.

In this role, you will continue to build on the Marketing team’s recent successes as Firefox’s Marketing program continues to expand its footprint throughout the funnel. You’ll look to support this success in owning global data strategy for Firefox Marketing, developing new data capabilities to unlock future business growth, collaborating with Data Science counterparts in other domains domains, and working closely across marketing and adjacent cross-functional teams to translate your team’s work into practical recommendations and enablement that drive Firefox’s growth.

What you’ll do:

  • Set the strategy and roadmap for Marketing Data Science, prioritizing the highest-impact opportunities with key partners.
  • Establish goals and measurement approaches for attribution, ROI, and campaign performance; deliver insights that improve marketing investment and outcomes.
  • Lead and develop the team’s core capabilities across:
    • Performance marketing: budget optimization, causal lift measurement, and conversion-signal testing
    • Brand marketing: measurement planning and assessment of long-term and lower-funnel impact
    • User insights: retention/LTV modeling and audience segmentation
    • Reporting and infrastructure: build self-service dashboards, deliver ad hoc and executive reporting, and develop scalable data models and internal tools that expand our understanding of the acquisition landscape.
  • Bring a forward-looking perspective on advertising, media innovation, and marketing analytics methods.
  • Partner with Data Science leaders to evaluate and responsibly adopt emerging AI tools that improve team workflows and impact.

What you’ll bring:

  • 6+ years of marketing data science experience, ideally at a media agency or in-house marketing organization.
  • Proficiency with marketing analytics tools, including Google Analytics and advertising platforms, and familiarity with modeling methods such as MMM, causal lift/synthetic control, saturation modeling, optimization, and Bayesian approaches.
  • Proven experience leading, mentoring, and developing talent, with strong stakeholder management and the ability to prioritize multiple complex workstreams.
  • Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to tailor data-driven insights and recommendations to different audiences.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

title: Solutions Engineer
description_html:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for an exceptional Solutions Engineer to help grow Infisical’s customer base and ensure a seamless product experience from onboarding to long-term success.

This is a high-impact, customer-facing role where you’ll work closely with our CEO, sales, and engineering teams. You'll play a critical role in helping organizations adopt Infisical by demonstrating technical value, driving successful implementations, and expanding product usage across accounts.

You’ll be working directly with the CEO, engineering, and sales teams on:

  • Running proof-of-concept with leads, guiding customer through onboarding, or being able to recommend best practices for specific architectures and use cases.

  • Ensuring new customers are activated, happy, and have all of their questions answered;

  • Becoming a trusted technical advisor to customer and business leaders.

  • Working in tandem with account executives to lead demo & discovery calls.

  • Talking to customers daily to find points of friction and potential improvement in any workflows, understanding customer's needs and provide feedback towards product roadmap.

  • Understanding user journey and being able to guide UX/DX roadmap

  • Hosting webinars and knowledge sharing sessions for customer's stakeholders.

  • Improving documentation and public facing materials based on customer feedback.

Overall, you’re going to be one of the defining pieces of our team as we scale to thousands of customers over the next 18 months.

Requirements

  • Prior experience in development, systems engineering, or DevOps (open source contributions are a plus).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills—able to clearly articulate technical concepts.

  • High energy, high ownership mindset, and a willingness to operate in ambiguity.

  • Based in the United States.

Bonus

  • Familiarity with secret management tools or developer security platforms.

  • Solid understanding of developer workflows and/or DevSecOps infrastructure.

  • Prior experience in a startup or fast-scaling environment.

  • Past involvement in developer communities or public speaking (webinars, talks, etc.).

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role (e.g., Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, DevRel).

  • Experience supporting enterprise accounts and working with technical stakeholders.

How You’ll Grow

In this role, you’ll be instrumental in shaping how Infisical scales and serves thousands of customers:

  • Drive technical success across a fast-growing customer base.

  • Influence the short and long-term product roadmap based on customer needs.

  • Help build out the future customer success and go-to-market teams & functions.

Team, Values & Benefits

Our team brings experience from companies like Figma, AWS, and Red Hat. We operate primarily as a remote team but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page.

title: Director, Partner Programs, Enablement, and Operations
description_html:
About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

Role overview

Ping Identity is seeking a strategic, highly execution-oriented Director, Partner Programs, Enablement & Operations to build the operating system that helps our partners create pipeline, win business, and deliver customer outcomes.

This role brings together three connected disciplines: partner program design, partner enablement, and chief-of-staff-style operating leadership. You will translate channel strategy into repeatable programs, equip partners and internal teams to execute, and establish the planning, measurement, and decision cadence required to scale our partner business.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing a global partner program, facilitating an executive decision, building a practical enablement journey, and turning an ambiguous cross-functional priority into a clear plan with owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

What you will do

Build and evolve the partner programs portfolio

  • Design and manage a coherent partner-program framework spanning recruitment, onboarding, activation, specialization, co-selling, services readiness, incentives, recognition, and lifecycle management.
  • Establish transparent principles for partner segmentation, prioritization, investment, access to strategic initiatives, and progression through the partner lifecycle.
  • Create program requirements, benefits, governance, operating guidelines, and communications that are simple for field teams and partners to understand and use.
  • Develop repeatable frameworks for joint business planning, partner commitments, mutual action plans, strategic partner agreements, and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Product, Marketing, Sales, Services, and Operations to ensure programs are scalable, economically sound, and aligned to company priorities.

Lead partner enablement and activation

  • Define the minimum partner-ready package for priority products and motions, including messaging, use cases, demos, pricing and SKU guidance, sales plays, presales support, delivery readiness, and customer proof.
  • Build role-based enablement journeys for partner executives, sellers, solution architects, consultants, delivery teams, and customer-success stakeholders.
  • Establish a practical calendar of onboarding, training, certification, launch, and reinforcement activities tied to partner and business outcomes.
  • Create the feedback loop that continuously improves enablement content based on partner adoption, field usage, win/loss evidence, and customer results.
  • Coordinate with Revenue Enablement, Product, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Experience, Marketing, and regional alliances leaders to eliminate duplication and close readiness gaps.
  • Champion fast, iterative delivery: put useful assets in partners’ hands early, measure usage and impact, and improve them based on evidence.

Operate as a chief-of-staff for the partner organization

  • Establish the partner organization’s operating cadence, including annual and quarterly planning, weekly execution reviews, pipeline and forecast inspection, executive readouts, and action follow-through.
  • Convert strategic priorities into integrated plans with clear owners, milestones, dependencies, decisions, and escalation paths.
  • Prepare leadership meetings, QBRs, business reviews, and executive partner engagements with concise narratives, decision materials, and recommended actions.
  • Maintain a single view of strategic initiatives, partner commitments, risks, cross-functional dependencies, and overdue or blocked actions.
  • Build dashboards and operating metrics that connect partner activity to pipeline, sourced and influenced revenue, activation, enablement adoption, delivery readiness, customer outcomes, and return on investment.
  • Improve clarity around partner attribution, field rules of engagement, investment decisions, incentives, and the handoffs between direct sales and partners.
  • Surface trade-offs early, drive decisions to closure, and ensure commitments are translated into accountable execution.

Drive executive and cross-functional alignment

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and connective tissue across Channel Alliances, Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Experience, Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations.
  • Build productive relationships with partner executives and internal leaders, earning credibility through sound judgment, responsiveness, and delivery.
  • Facilitate complex decisions where priorities, resources, or ownership are unclear.
  • Support strategic partner motions, including executive alignment, joint go-to-market planning, customer engagement, and mutual investment discussions.
  • Provide clear, data-informed recommendations to senior leadership on partner priorities, programs, enablement investments, and operating model improvements.

Build the capability and culture

  • Lead through influence across a distributed, global organization and build a high-accountability, partner-first culture.
  • Develop program, enablement, and operations capabilities through hiring, coaching, clear role design, reusable processes, and strong cross-functional partnerships.
  • Establish standards for high-quality planning, communication, measurement, and follow-through.

What success looks like

In the first 12 months, you will:

  • Launch a clear partner-program and enablement operating model with defined ownership, governance, milestones, and success measures.
  • Establish a prioritized partner portfolio and transparent criteria for investment, access, activation, and progression.
  • Deliver a measurable enablement plan for priority products and partner motions, with adoption and business-impact reporting.
  • Improve the quality and consistency of partner pipeline inspection, attribution, forecasting, and executive reporting.
  • Create a dependable operating cadence that closes decisions, exposes risks early, and improves cross-functional execution.
  • Demonstrate stronger partner engagement, field adoption, and measurable contribution to pipeline, revenue, and customer outcomes.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Approximately 9–11 years of experience in partner programs, channel strategy, alliances, revenue operations, sales enablement, business operations, or a related discipline.
  • Experience in a software, cloud, cybersecurity, identity, or other technology ecosystem with complex partner motions.
  • Demonstrated success designing and scaling partner programs, enablement programs, or cross-functional operating models.
  • Strong program-management and operating-rhythm skills, including planning, prioritization, dependency management, metrics, and executive communication.
  • Ability to move between strategy and execution: define the model, make the plan, align stakeholders, and drive delivery.
  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, influencing, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong business judgment and comfort making recommendations with incomplete information.
  • Experience working across Sales, Marketing, Product, Services, Finance, Legal, and Operations.
  • High ownership, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a rapidly changing environment.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with global system integrators, regional system integrators, distributors, resellers, cloud marketplaces, or technology partners.
  • Experience building partner tiering, specialization, incentives, investment, onboarding, certification, or co-selling programs.
  • Experience translating product launches into partner-ready go-to-market and delivery motions.
  • Experience running executive operating cadences, QBRs, leadership reviews, or chief-of-staff/business-operations functions.
  • Familiarity with CRM, partner relationship management, analytics, planning, and collaboration tools.
  • Experience in identity and access management, cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise infrastructure.
  • MBA or other relevant advanced degree.

title: Senior Integrated Campaign Manager
description_html:
At Feedzai, we're building a world of safer money. A world where financial institutions move faster than criminals. Where the payments that fund real lives through salaries, savings, and businesses are protected in real time. We use trusted AI to detect and prevent financial crime, fraud, and money laundering at scale: the world's top banks, payment networks, and acquirers trust our technology to safeguard more than one billion consumers and $9 trillion in payment volume every year.

Feedzai is a Series D company and has raised $282M to date. With a valuation of $2 billion, our technology protects 1 billion consumers and 90 billion transactions each year.

The Marketing Team is empowered to spark change daily with MAP - Mastery in their role, Autonomy to make decisions, and a Purpose to make the world a safer place for all consumers. Using cutting-edge tech and delivering best-in-class content, they influence the trajectory of our company. It’s this team spirit and trust in each other that let us go further together. This team has two simple goals: 1. Everyone in the world knows about the Feedzai brand 2. Making sure our sales team is busy. Join Us!

We’re looking for a strategic, data‑driven Campaign Manager to architect, lead, and orchestrate Feedzai’s largest global marketing campaigns. Feedzai’s campaigns are the connective tissue between brand, product, and growth. As Campaign Manager, you’ll turn business priorities into clear campaign strategies, align cross-functional teams around the plan, and drive the programs that build awareness, generate demand and accelerate pipeline.

You:

You’re a strategic full-funnel marketer who knows how to turn business priorities into clear, measurable campaign strategies. You thrive in complex, fast-moving environments, bringing structure to ambiguity and momentum to cross-functional teams. You’re a natural orchestrator who can build alignment, drive accountability and confidently communicate with senior stakeholders. You stay close to performance, know how to spot what isn’t working, and bring the right teams together to fix it.

Your Day to Day:

  • Design and lead multi-channel, full-funnel campaigns tied to Feedzai’s strategic GTM motions and growth priorities.
  • Translate business priorities into clear campaign goals, audiences, messaging, buyer journeys, routes to market and success metrics.
  • Orchestrate teams across Product Marketing, Digital, Content, Comms, Creative, Regional Marketing, Partner Marketing, ADRs and Sales to deliver against one integrated campaign strategy.
  • Identify critical gaps in audience, market intelligence, positioning, product readiness or sales follow-up and work with the right stakeholders to resolve them.
  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate positioning, buyer insights and product priorities into differentiated full-funnel messaging.
  • Stay close to campaign, lead and pipeline performance, working with Digital, ADRs and Sales to quickly identify issues and optimize messaging, targeting, channels and follow-up.
  • Build campaign enablement that gives Sales and ADR teams the messaging, content and outreach guidance needed to convert engagement and accelerate pipeline.
  • Lead campaign reviews, clearly communicating performance, learnings, risks, recommendations and next steps.
  • Manage multiple complex campaigns at once, bringing structure, accountability and momentum in a fast-moving environment.

title: Director, Sales (Middle East)
description_html:
About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

The Sales Director will have full Middle East territory responsibility and will be tasked with influencing and developing an energized, competitive, high impact sales team that is characterized by its ability to create differentiated value for our customer base.

We’re looking for a seasoned leader from within the SaaS enterprise marketplace, with proven software solution selling combined with success in a fast growth business. This leader will be a model to drive the team in building extraordinary customer relationships and experiences, leveraging a strong teamwork approach, and cross matrix collaboration across all Ping functions. This role will demonstrate a depth of understanding when working alongside a partner community and posess a well-established customer and partner network in the Middle East region.

In order to acquire, develop and retain customer relationships and create a winning Ping business, this leader will be able to create and maintain a high-performance culture, that is grounded in data, transparency, accountability, and agility. The ideal candidate’s mindset should be customer-focused, people-oriented, open, passionate, and authentic.

Responsibilities:

  • Creates, implements, measures and reviews a strategic or operational plan that drives achievement of business goals aligned to overall Ping strategy
  • Uses mechanisms such as territory planning, account plans, opportunity inspection, pipeline management, account reviews, forecast calls, etc.
  • Advises and coaches the sales team around how to position and articulate Ping Identity’s value proposition at enterprise customers, thus increasing the average deal size
  • Identifies and pursues opportunities to expand business activities within areas of responsibility
  • Leverages GSIs & other partners to help source, develop and progress business
  • Plans and controls the expense associated with the area of responsibility even if not responsible for overall cost center
  • Establishes working relationships with external parties which supports the achievement of business goals
  • Is conversant with Ping Identity’s systems and procedures and ensures effective use of and conformance to standard business practices and tools (i.e. SFDC – SalesForce.com)
  • Communicates Ping Identity’s vision and aligns team and personal goals to achieve business results
  • Provides direction and guidance, mentoring and development of the field team
  • Lives teamwork and promotes cross-functional collaboration
  • Recruits, builds and develops the team to deliver business results; Identifies, develops and promotes high potential employees
  • Recommends and/or approves people-related decisions – hiring, promotions, merit increases, rewards & recognition, training initiatives, etc.
  • Drives performance review and development planning process with annual and quarterly review meetings
  • Has established multi-vertical C level contacts in large enterprise customers
  • Has an established partner/SI network and is used to working with partners on projects
  • Builds relationships with customers (internal or external) as necessary providing customer escalation management as necessary for problem resolution
  • Provides support for customer relationship management as necessary and drives initiatives which result in improvement in customer satisfaction
  • Drives initiatives which result in improvement in customer satisfaction

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Proven experience of successfully leading sales teams focused on the Middle East territory
  • Expertise in enterprise software, SaaS, managed services and strategic account management
  • Results-oriented with multiple years meeting or exceeding quota
  • Flexibility to travel to the Middle East region
  • Transitioned a team through on-prem to SaaS solutions
  • Adept working in a fast-growing global organization
  • Good interpersonal skills to align and foster positive working relationships across the organization

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits:

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule
  • Parental Leave
  • Progressive Healthcare Options
  • Retirement Programs
  • Opportunity for Education Reimbursement
  • Commuter Offset (Specific locations)

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Design Engineer, Site
description_html:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

About the role

We’re looking for an exceptional Design Engineer (Site) to own https://infisical.com and show the world what we're about.

In this role, you'll work with engineering, design, and marketing to be the go-to person for everything having to do with building and maintaining the design and infrastructure of the landing page; we want this surface to be iconic and performant to drive organic traffic and user adoption.

This role is for someone who has a frontend-leaning full stack engineering background, who obsesses over crafting pixel-perfect experiences, cares about building sound underlying infrastructure, and is motivated to help build out our growth engine.

You'll work closely with our co-founder, engineering, design, and marketing to:

  • Design and ship pixel-perfect, reusable components and complex designs.

  • Build and maintain core website pages (home, product, blogs, learning/resource hub etc.), microsites, frontend architecture, code quality, CMS integration and experience.

  • Implement SEO best practices, run A/B tests, and optimize conversion funnels.

  • Integrate analytics, attribution, and marketing tooling - Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, HubSpot, etc.

Requirements

  • Deep mastery of JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and frameworks like React/Next.js.

  • Experience building high-quality frontend systems and components with strong attention to performance, accessibility, and maintainability.

  • Experience with web design and design systems.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and eagerness to learn.

  • Bias toward action: able to make decisions, iterate quickly, and take calculated risks.

  • Based in the Americas (SF preferred) or able to work EST hours.

Nice to have

  • Technical SEO fundamentals.

  • Experience with CMS platforms (e.g. Contentful, Sanity, etc.).

  • Experience configuring website analytics/marketing platform integrations such as with Google Analytics and HubSpot.

  • Experience with developer-facing products or startups.

Team, values & benefits

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page.

description_html:
Please note this is a permanent role and we prefer a hybrid working model; we are flexible with remote working as long as you can meet with the team in our London studio in-person now and then.

Please note we cannot support VISA + relocation for this role.

At Framestore’s Oscar-winning Technology team, innovation is at the heart of what we do, whether this be developing new techniques, new ideas or creative new ways to tell our clients’ stories. Underpinning all of this is a long tradition of research, technology and development - from engineering our bespoke software solutions to gaining early access to bleeding-edge technology and forging vibrant partnerships with leading academic and scientific institutions.

Framestore combines talent and technology to bring life to everything we create. Driven by creativity and inspired by the future, we set out every day to reframe the possible.

About the role

We are looking for a Cloud DevOps Developer to help us take a modern, cloud-forward approach to development. You’ll help deploy scalable and secure serverless infrastructure in order to deliver some of our latest products and services used for modern advertising and brand management. You will be part of a small agile team working closely with artists and other technology teams.

Your main focus will be on designing and deploying cloud infrastructure and enhancing developer workflows to support a fast paced, agile iteration and deployment cycle.

What you’ll do

  • Deploy, maintain, and optimize our cloud services using Terraform and other modern cloud orchestration tools.

  • Champion Agile methodologies, focusing heavily on continuous delivery and test-driven development.

  • Enhance observability, telemetry, monitoring, and alerting of our platform and services.

  • Accelerate our development processes by building and optimising powerful tooling and deployment pipelines.

  • Collaborate with our Pipeline and Systems teams to integrate cloud and DevOps solutions.

  • Explore and harness AI techniques to assist in code and media generation where appropriate.


What we are looking for

  • Hands-on experience with Terraform or similar cloud infrastructure provisioning tools.

  • Exceptional communication and eager learning skills.

  • A solid grasp of modern software development practices and a desire to measure and log everything.

  • The ability to problem-solve independently and write high-quality code without an over-reliance on AI tools.

You might also have

  • VFX/Animation pipeline experience.

  • Experience working with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Accessibility Statement

Our London studio is fully accessible, with step-free entry, accessible toilets on all floors, and quiet spaces available. We are committed to supporting disabled colleagues and providing an inclusive workplace for everyone.

Application Process & Deadline

To apply, please complete the linked application form or email your resume and portfolio to ----- with the subject line: Cloud DevOps Developer - London.

We review all applications manually and do not use artificial intelligence to screen candidates. If you require any adjustments or support during the application process, please let us know - we are happy to accommodate your needs.

title: Lead Brand (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Next Lotto GmbH
description_html:
Ein kleines Stück Papier mit Zahlen, die das Potenzial haben, ein Leben für immer zu verändern! Ok…ersetzten wir das Papier durch eine App und eine Person gegen 600.000+ Nutzer monatlich. This is our Business!

📌 Deine Mission

Als Lead Brand (m/w/d) verantwortest du, wie NextLotto auftritt und wächst – Markenstrategie, Positionierung und Identität – sowie die großen Investments, die die Marke aufbauen: Corporate Identity, Sponsorings und Partner-Aktivierungen. In dieser operativen Führungsrolle berichtest du an den Head of Marketing: Du gibst die Markenführung vor und steuerst die Brand Health, bleibst dabei hands-on über Partnerschaften, PR und die öffentliche Präsenz des CEO – und führst und baust ein kleines Team auf, zunächst Influencer Marketing und PR, später erweitert um Partnerschaften.

Aufgaben

  • Markenstrategie & Positionierung – Du verantwortest Positionierung, Zielgruppen-Fokus und die Strategie, die Marke bei der Wunsch-Zielgruppe schnell wachsen zu lassen.
  • Brand Campaigns & Storytelling – Du entwickelst und steuerst die großen Markenideen und integrierten Kampagnen, die Bekanntheit, Consideration und Präferenz bei der Zielgruppe aufbauen.
  • Brand Identity, Assets, Tone of Voice & Guardrails – Du besitzt das Identity-System, die Brand-Assets, den Tone of Voice und die CI-Guidelines als Brand Guardian. Du gibst die kreative Markenrichtung vor und briefst die Umsetzung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Creative Lead; Creative Production und finale kreative Freigabe liegen beim Creative-Team. Stets im Rahmen der deutschen Glücksspielregulierung (GlüStV).
  • Customer Journey & Brand Experience – Du sorgst dafür, dass die Marke über Produkt, CRM, Social, Performance und Partnerschaften hinweg konsistent erlebbar ist.
  • Brand Health & Measurement – Du verantwortest das Brand-Health-Tracking: Share of Voice, Share of Search, Brand Lift, gestützte/ungestützte Bekanntheit, Reach vs. Frequency – und steuerst auf Marken-Outcomes, nicht auf Impressions.
  • Partnerschaften & Aktivierung (DTM) – Du steuerst das DTM-Sponsoring sowie zukünftige Partnerschaften ganzheitlich (Briefing, Planung, Vor-Ort-Präsenz, Nachbereitung) und führst Agenturen sowie Operations.
  • Influencer & Creator Marketing – Du verantwortest die Creator-Partnerschaften und die Kampagnenstrategie mit Blick auf Messbarkeit. Content und Produktion liegen beim Creative-Team; enge Abstimmung mit dem Performance-/Media-Team bei bezahltem Influencer-Budget.
  • PR & Executive Communications – Du baust Beziehungen zu deutschen Consumer-, Fintech- und Lottery-Medien auf, sicherst Interview-Platzierungen und steuerst die öffentliche Präsenz des CEO (B2C, inkl. LinkedIn-Ghostwriting). Ein Teilzeit-Strang, später an eine dedizierte PR-Rolle übergeben.

Deine Ziele in dieser Rolle (Impact):

  • Markenbekanntheit & Consideration steigern – bei der Zielgruppe, gemessen an Brand Health (Share of Voice, Share of Search, Brand Lift, gestützte/ungestützte Bekanntheit) – nicht an Impressions.
  • Partnerschaften verankern – Partnerbeziehungen und Aktivierungsstrategie ganzheitlich verantworten und das DTM-Sponsoring direkt mit der Marke verknüpfen.
  • CI von uneinheitlich zu „owned“ – dokumentierte, durchgesetzte Brand Voice + Corporate Identity über Creative-, Paid-, Social- und Partner-Kanäle.
  • PR- & Earned-Media-Präsenz aufbauen in deutschen Consumer-/Fintech-/Lottery-Medien, plus aktive Corporate-Influencer-Frequenz für den CEO (B2C).
  • Team aufbauen & ausbauen – das Brand-Team aufbauen und entwickeln (Influencer Marketing, PR, Partnerships).

Qualifikation

Must-have:

  • Markenstrategie & Positionierung – nachweisliche Erfahrung, eine Consumer-Marke zielgruppengerecht zu positionieren und wachsen zu lassen.
  • Brand Voice & CI in der Praxis – verankert und durchgesetzt, nicht nur Guidelines erstellt.
  • Brand Health / Measurement – vertraut mit Share of Voice, Brand Lift, Bekanntheit und Reach/Frequency (Outcomes statt Impressions).
  • Partner-, Sponsoring- & Aktivierungs-Management – externe Partner-/Sponsorenbeziehungen verantwortet und eine Marke extern repräsentiert.
  • Hands-on in Umsetzung & Führung – steuert Design, schreibt und liefert selbst (kein reines Strategie-Profil); hat ein kleines Team geführt oder gementort.
  • Hands-on-Erfahrung in PR, Earned Media und Executive Thought Leadership.
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachen- oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau plus starkes Englisch, mit fundierten Kenntnissen des DACH-Consumer-Marktes und der Medien.

Nice-to-have:

  • Erfahrung in Sport-, Event- oder Sponsoring-Aktivierung (DTM-relevant).
  • Erfahrung in Produkt-/Launch-Positionierung.
  • Markenkommunikation im regulierten Umfeld (Lotterie, Fintech, Gaming).
  • Kombinierte Erfahrung aus Agentur- und Inhouse-Markenarbeit.
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau der Personal Brand von Gründer:innen oder Executives.

Deine Soft Skills:

  • Strategisch & analytisch – denkt in Positionierung, Zielgruppen und Marken-Outcomes.
  • Flexibel & breit aufgestellt – wechselt mühelos zwischen Brand, Partnerschaften, PR und Exec-Support.
  • Starker Außenauftritt & Stakeholder-Management – vertritt NextLotto souverän gegenüber Sponsoren, Partnern und Medien; steuert Agenturen, Management und interne Teams.
  • Hands-on, eigenverantwortlich & Macher-Mentalität – setzt selbst um und schafft Strukturen, wo bisher keine existieren.
  • Starker Storyteller & pragmatischer Brand Guardian – schreibt klar, schnell und im richtigen Markenton; hält die Marke konsistent, ohne zum Nadelöhr zu werden.
  • Diskret, vertrauenswürdig & Startup-fit – handhabt Executive-Visibility und Partnerverhandlungen mit Fingerspitzengefühl; sicher in einem dynamischen Umfeld.
  • Hands-on Führungskraft – führt und entwickelt ein kleines interdisziplinäres Team und bleibt selbst operativ.

Dein Background – Ausbildung & Erfahrung:

  • 7–10 Jahre in Brand, Marketing oder Communications mit operativem Fokus auf B2C-Consumer-Marken.
  • B2C-Erfahrung ist essenziell.
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Betreuung von Partner- und Sponsorenbeziehungen sowie Markenaktivierungen.
  • Fundierte Markt- und Medienkenntnisse der deutschen bzw. DACH-Region.
  • Bonus: Sport-/Sponsoring-Aktivierung, Produkt-Launches oder Markenführung im regulierten Umfeld.
  • Bachelor-Abschluss oder vergleichbare praktische Qualifikation.

Benefits

Was wir dir bieten:

Vergütung & Work-Life-Balance:

  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.
  • 30 Urlaubstage im Jahr
  • 2 zusätzliche Feiertage (24.12, 31.12)
  • Großzügiges Weiterbildungsbudget
  • Ausgefallene Teamevents
  • Innovatives Benefit-Programm

Kommunikation & Vertrauen:

  • Eine offene, ehrliche und direkte Kommunikation. Deine Ideen sind willkommen!
  • Ein Feedbackgespräch jedes Quartals, um gemeinsam zu wachsen.

Modernes Arbeiten:

  • Alles, was du für deinen Arbeitsalltag brauchst: MacBook, Kopfhörer, u.v.m.
  • Ein modernes und inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld in Berlin oder in Konstanz am Bodensee.

Individuelle Weiterbildung:

  • Ein Weiterbildungs-Tag pro Monat und ein großzügiges Weiterbildungsbudget für deine persönliche Entwicklung.

Buddy-Programm:

  • Ein erfahrener Teamkollege begleitet dich von Anfang an, um dir bei deinem Einstieg zu helfen.

Das Team

  • Wir sind ein bunt gemixter Haufen aus unterschiedlichen Nationen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen. Wir unterscheiden nicht nach Religion, Geschlecht, Alter, Familienstand… . Für uns steht im Mittelpunkt was du kannst!

🪴Unsere Werte:

MAKE IT HAPPEN 💪🏼

  • Ergebnisse erzielen – Übernimm Verantwortung für Problem, Ziel und Ergebnis durch Selbstorganisation und datenbasierte Entscheidungen.
  • Mutig sprechen – Fordere Ideen heraus und nenne Probleme direkt, wenn es drauf ankommt.
  • Dinge erledigen – Sei pragmatisch, halte den Schwung und bringe Energie rein.
  • Wertvolle Wirkung erzeugen – Stelle Lösungen bereit, die unsere Mission und strategischen Ziele vorantreiben.

WIN TOGETHER 💚

  • Offen und respektvoll kommunizieren – Sei transparent, gehe von guten Absichten aus und stelle dein Ego zurück, wenn du mit anderen interagierst.
  • Anderen zum Erfolg verhelfen – Teile proaktiv Wissen, Zeit und Stärken in interdisziplinären Teams.
  • Über Kulturen hinweg arbeiten – Lerne aus diversen Perspektiven und passe deinen Stil aktiv an, um vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit in diversen Teams zu ermöglichen.
  • Teamgeist wecken – Schaffe Momente der Freude und Verbundenheit, die zu großen Erfolgen führen.

SHAPE THE FUTURE 🚀

  • Experimentieren, um zu lernen – Führe Tests durch, messe Ergebnisse, behandle Fehler als Lernchance und setze Erkenntnisse um.
  • Chancen erkennen – Bleib nah am Kunden und Markttrends, um das Nächste zu identifizieren.
  • Nutzerzentrierte Innovation bauen – Nutze zuverlässige, datenbasierte Lösungen und Services, die den Maßstab setzen.
  • Dich selbst weiterentwickeln – Hinterfrage deine Arbeitsweise, hole Feedback ein und baue deine Fähigkeiten aus.

Klingt nach Dir? Wir freuen uns Dich kennenzulernen!

title: Data Analyst (m/w/d) Power BI
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at G&N Gruppe
description_html:
Warum G&N?

22 Standorte, viele unterschiedliche Systeme und jeden Tag mehr Daten: Bei der G&N Gruppe passiert viel. Unsere Power BI-Landschaft ist bereits gruppenweit im Einsatz und liefert heute wichtige Auswertungen für unsere Standorte, Fachbereiche und das Management. Gleichzeitig wachsen wir weiter, organisch und durch neue Unternehmen und Standorte. Damit wachsen auch unsere Datenmengen und die Anforderungen an unsere Systeme. Gleichzeitig möchten wir die Möglichkeiten von Automatisierung und KI künftig noch stärker nutzen, um unsere Geschäftsprozesse weiterzuentwickeln. Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel.

Wir suchen jemanden, der nicht einfach nur Reports baut, sondern verstehen möchte, wie unsere Systeme und Daten zusammenspielen und wie wir daraus noch mehr machen können.

Du hast die Chance, unsere gruppenweite Daten- und Power BI-Landschaft aktiv mitzugestalten, bestehende Strukturen weiterzuentwickeln und neue Lösungen aufzubauen. Dabei beschäftigst Du Dich auch mit der Frage, wo KI-Anwendungen in unseren Geschäftsprozessen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen können, und begleitest deren Einführung.

Das erwartet Dich

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Ein abwechslungsreiches Umfeld in einer wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene, kollegiale Zusammenarbeit
  • Die Möglichkeit, unsere Daten- und Reportinglandschaft aktiv weiterzuentwickeln
  • Ein Thema mit viel Zukunft: Du gestaltest mit, wie G&N künftig mit Daten arbeitet

Aufgaben

Als Data Analyst (m/w/d) für Power BI bist Du die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Daten-, Reporting- und BI-Themen. Du verbindest technisches Know-how mit einem guten Verständnis für unsere Geschäftsprozesse und entwickelst unsere gruppenweite Datenlandschaft gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen weiter.

  • Du bringst Daten aus unterschiedlichen Systemen wie HR Works, DATEV, CRM, ES Office und weiteren Anwendungen zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass daraus eine verlässliche Grundlage für unser gruppenweites Reporting entsteht.
  • Mit Power BI konzipierst und optimierst Du Dashboards, Reports und Management-Auswertungen und stellst sicher, dass Kennzahlen verständlich, aussagekräftig und für unterschiedliche Nutzergruppen sinnvoll aufbereitet sind.
  • Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für den Einsatz von KI-Anwendungen zur Optimierung unserer Geschäftsprozesse. Gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen identifizierst Du sinnvolle Anwendungsfälle, bewertest geeignete Lösungen und begleitest deren Implementierung und Weiterentwicklung. Dabei geht es nicht um KI um der KI willen, sondern um Lösungen, die im Arbeitsalltag einen konkreten Mehrwert schaffen.
  • Unsere Datenmodelle, Schnittstellen und Architekturen entwickelst Du kontinuierlich weiter und hast dabei Datenqualität, Performance, Skalierbarkeit und Wartbarkeit im Blick. Bestehende Lösungen hinterfragst Du regelmäßig und entwickelst sie dort weiter, wo unser Wachstum neue Anforderungen schafft.
  • Mit SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Power Automate und weiteren Microsoft-Technologien entwickelst Du Datenintegrationen und automatisierst wiederkehrende Reporting- und Geschäftsprozesse.
  • Gemeinsam mit Finance, Controlling, Vertrieb und weiteren Fachbereichen übersetzt Du fachliche Anforderungen in passende Daten- und BI-Lösungen und hilfst dabei, relevante KPIs und Kennzahlen einheitlich zu definieren und weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Von der ersten Idee über die Konzeption und technische Umsetzung bis zur Einführung und Weiterentwicklung übernimmst Du Verantwortung für Power BI-, Reporting- und Datenprojekte.
  • Du sorgst für nachvollziehbare Dokumentation, einheitliche Reporting-Standards und eine hohe Datenqualität und entwickelst unsere Governance und Best Practices im Power BI-Umfeld kontinuierlich weiter.

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Datenanalyse oder in einer vergleichbaren Position sowie ein abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Data Analytics, Betriebswirtschaft mit IT-Schwerpunkt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Power BI und SQL sowie praktische Erfahrung mit Datenmodellierung, relationalen Datenbanken und der Entwicklung von ETL-/ELT-Prozessen und Datenintegrationen.
  • Im Microsoft-Datenumfeld fühlst Du Dich zu Hause und hast idealerweise bereits mit Microsoft Fabric, Power Automate und weiteren Microsoft-Technologien gearbeitet. Auch mit Performanceoptimierung und dem Aufbau skalierbarer BI-Lösungen solltest Du vertraut sein.
  • Ein gutes Verständnis für betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und Kennzahlen hilft Dir dabei, die Anforderungen unserer Fachbereiche zu verstehen und daraus sinnvolle Daten- und BI-Lösungen zu entwickeln idealerweise bringst Du Erfahrung in Finance, Controlling, Vertrieb oder einem vergleichbaren operativen Umfeld mit.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert, hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und hast Freude daran, Dinge nicht nur zu verwalten, sondern weiterzuentwickeln und zu verbessern.
  • Auch komplexe technische Zusammenhänge kannst Du verständlich vermitteln und arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen und Stakeholdern zusammen. Dabei gehst Du verantwortungsvoll mit sensiblen Unternehmensdaten um.
  • Du arbeitest gerne nah an den Fachbereichen und möchtest Geschäftsprozesse nicht nur aus der technischen Perspektive kennenlernen. title: Client Services Manager, Projects and Campaigns
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at BLUE Communications
description_html:
BLUE is a specialist global B2B communications consultancy for organisations operating in complex, high-value industries - such as maritime, marine leisure, energy and carbon markets. Since 2008, we've turned market expertise into influence and impact, helping clients lead conversations, shape markets and unlock growth.

Our credibility comes from deep immersion, not observation. We get close enough to our clients' businesses to understand what motivates them, and what keeps them awake at night, so we can operate as true consultants, not just a delivery team. It's why our clients stay, and why we've built long-term partnerships across some of the most complex, high-value industries there are.

The role

A Client Services Manager at BLUE is responsible for the day-to-day management, strategic direction, commercial health and delivery of projects and campaigns to both retained and project-based clients. You will act as the principal link between our clients and the agency’s internal specialist teams (PR & Communications, Digital marketing, Brand, Creative and Insight). With your strong relationship management skills and communications expertise, you will ensure that all projects and campaigns are delivered to a high standard, protect client reputations, and align seamlessly with their overarching business objectives.

Tasks

Project management & delivery

  • Become the primary point of contact for projects and campaigns, project managing multi-channel work under tight media deadlines
  • Translate high-level strategy into projects that exceed client expectations, built on strong relationships with client communications leads
  • Ensure all output meets brief and brand standards, coordinating reviews and approvals across internal teams and clients

Evaluation & reporting

  • Monitor and report on campaign delivery against agreed KPIs, project time, resource use and profitability
  • Proactively flag scope creep and drive efficiencies to keep every project commercially viable
  • Work with account and finance teams on time measurement, budget integration and approvals

Briefing & traffic management

  • Lead the intake of briefs from clients, clarifying scope, objectives, deliverables, timelines and budget
  • Translate briefs into actionable plans for designers, copywriters and other creative resource
  • Manage internal workflows and coordinate across teams to ensure smooth execution, flagging challenges and proposing solutions

Business development

  • Work alongside account managers to identify opportunities within retained and project-based client accounts
  • Collaborate across BLUE's brand, creative, digital marketing and insight teams to integrate capabilities into broader campaigns
  • Contribute to new business pitches, RFP proposals, and BLUE's own marketing content and case studies

Culture & leadership

  • Live by and promote BLUE's brand values, driving sustainability and excellence across the marine and energy sectors
  • Be an authoritative voice for the client services department, guiding the wider team on project and campaign best practice
  • Actively participate in team meetings, brainstorming workshops and collaborative internal sessions

Requirements

Essential

  • Proven experience managing multi-channel projects or campaigns in an agency environment, ideally spanning PR, digital, brand or creative disciplines
  • Strong commercial acumen and comfortable managing budgets, profitability and scope across multiple live projects
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, confident briefing and coordinating creative, digital and PR specialists
  • Proven ability to prioritise and deliver under tight, often media-driven deadlines
  • A strategic mindset, able to translate high-level briefs into clear, actionable plans

Desirable

  • Experience in, or genuine curiosity about, the marine, renewable energy or wider sustainability sectors
  • Experience contributing to new business pitches or formal RFP proposals
  • Familiarity with campaign reporting, evaluation tools and budget-tracking processes

Benefits

  • Hybrid working, with a 4pm Friday finish encouraged
  • Dog friendly offices
  • A charity donation made in your name on your birthday and the day off
  • Employee of the Quarter recognition
  • Additional annual leave after 2 years
  • New Business commission scheme
  • Employee assistance scheme
  • Two centrally located UK offices, fully stocked with food and drink
  • Regular team socials, from dragon boat racing to scavenger hunts
  • Perk Box access and discounts
  • Salary sacrifice pension scheme
  • ‘Work from anywhere’ policy (2 weeks, after 1 year of service)
  • A genuine stake in a growing, purpose-led consultancy
  • Opportunity for international travel and events
  • Weekly T@3 for knowledge sharing
  • Loyalty bonuses

title: HR & Recruitment Lead (m/f/d) | Part-Time
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at MultiBase GmbH
description_html:
Location: Remote, CET-2 to CET+2

Hours: Part-time, 20 hours per week, ideally spread across four or five weekdays

Start: As soon as possible

You will own the people side of MultiBase for a small, international consulting team. Your primary focus is making sure colleagues feel heard, supported and clear about their development. Recruitment is a secondary responsibility when hiring needs arise.

This is a hands-on standalone role with no direct reports, reporting directly to the management.

About MultiBase

MultiBase is a specialist business intelligence and analytics consultancy, founded in 1991. We work with mid-sized companies across Germany, Austria and Switzerland to turn data into profit. MultiBase has delivered more than 1,500 projects for over 400 clients.

We are around 20 people, working remotely across Germany, Romania, India, Brazil, Pakistan and South Africa. English is our working language. We are building an AI-accelerated consulting business with its own products.

Tasks

Your role

You will create a consistent people rhythm for the team: regular contact, development conversations, onboarding, goals and skills records. You will spot issues early, listen well and bring senior management practical recommendations.

When we hire, you will run a reliable recruitment process and give candidates a professional experience. You work independently within agreed criteria and bring senior management a clear recommendation when approval is required.

People management and development

  • Build regular contact with the team and provide a trusted, discreet point of contact.
  • Run quarterly development conversations, independently or with the management.
  • Make sure every colleague has clear, current goals in Sage HR and a current skills record in MuchSkills.
  • Own the new-starter experience so that each remote joiner has a strong start
  • Identify people issues early and bring management a practical recommendation.
  • Make sure agreed actions, development commitments and important conversations are properly documented.

Recruitment

  • Own approved searches from vacancy brief to signed contract when hiring is required.
  • Write and publish adverts, manage applications, screen candidates and hold structured first conversations.
  • Run the hiring process: application, culture test, case study and interview with management.
  • Coordinate external recruiters where needed and keep each search moving.
  • Give every candidate a meaningful update within two working days after each stage.
  • Decide early-stage progression and rejections within agreed criteria.

How you will work with our German office team

You own people management, candidate communication, development rhythm, onboarding experience, employee contact, goals and skills records.

Our backoffice owns personnel administration, employment-contract administration, payroll inputs, absence records, local compliance and coordination with external counsel. You coordinate each new starter's onboarding together.

AI and automation will reduce routine administration. You remain accountable for quality, confidentiality and sound judgement in people matters.

Requirements

What you bring

  • At least three years in HR, recruitment or people operations, ideally in a small company, scale-up or agency.
  • Experience holding development conversations and building trusted relationships with colleagues.
  • Proven experience running recruitment processes: screening, structured first conversations, candidate communication and pipeline management.
  • Strong organisation and documentation discipline.
  • Sound judgement with confidential employee and candidate information.
  • Cross-cultural awareness and fluent business English, written and spoken. This is essential.
  • Practical daily use of AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude, with careful review of outputs.
  • A reliable remote setup and at least three to four working hours of overlap with Central European working hours.
  • Residence between CET-2 and CET+2, with the right to work in your country of residence.

Useful, but not required: German proficiency. If candidates are equally strong overall, German capability is an advantage. Experience hiring data, BI or software professionals. Experience with Sage HR, MuchSkills or similar tools. Experience in a distributed international team.

What success looks like

After 3 months: You know every team member's role, goals and current development commitments. The quarterly review cycle has a clear date, owner and template. New joiners have a consistent and positive first-two-week experience.

After 6 months: Goals and skills records are current. Team members know where to raise concerns and development needs. When a search is active, candidates get clear answers within days and the process moves without senior management chasing it.

Benefits

What we offer

  • Direct access to the management and real ownership of a function.
  • A part-time role with meaningful responsibility.
  • Budget for the AI tools you need for your work.
  • Competitive compensation, discussed individually.

How to apply

Apply with your CV and tell us which country you live in. No cover letter is needed. Bonus: include a short paragraph about one people or recruitment situation you handled: what happened, what you did and what you learned.

Our process includes a short practical case study before the interview with senior management. We read every application and respond to every candidate.

MultiBase GmbH

MultiBase is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation or disability.

title: Geschäftsführender Partner (m/w/d) für Interim Manager und Berater: Mandate im Retainer statt Projekte im Tagessatz

company.name: thexton armstrong Nord und Ost Deutschland

salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at thexton armstrong Nord und Ost Deutschland
description_html:
Sie arbeiten als Interim Manager oder Berater und kennen die Grenzen des Projektgeschäfts: Jeder Auftrag beginnt mit einer unbezahlten Angebotsphase und endet mit dem Abschlussbericht. Wir bieten Ihnen ein Modell, in dem Mandate über monatliche Retainer laufen, in der Regel über zwölf Monate, mit fünf bis zehn Mandanten parallel, und in dem Sie mit Kollegen in fünf Ländern arbeiten statt allein.

Unter der Marke thexton armstrong laden wir erfahrene Berater ein, als geschäftsführende Partner ihre eigene Beratungsgesellschaft in Nord- oder Ostdeutschland aufzubauen. Sie behalten Ihre Unabhängigkeit und gewinnen ein Angebot, das Inhaber sofort verstehen, ein Verfahren für den Einstieg beim Mandanten und eine Marke mit messbaren Ergebnissen.

Ein Punkt vorweg: Sie arbeiten mit der Methodik von thexton armstrong, nicht mit Ihrer eigenen. Wer das als Gewinn sieht, passt zu uns.

Über thexton armstrong

Die Beratungsgesellschaft thexton armstrong ist ein internationales Netzwerk selbständiger Partner, spezialisiert auf die Begleitung von Geschäftsinhabern im Mittelstand und auf Wachstumsberatung. Seit 2012 haben unsere Partner mehreren tausend Geschäftsinhabern geholfen, Ertragskraft, Widerstandsfähigkeit und den langfristigen Wert ihrer Unternehmen zu steigern. Grundlage ist eine strukturierte Methodik, die praktische Führungserfahrung mit messbaren Ergebnissen verbindet.

Wir sind selbst Unternehmer. Jeder Partner führt seine eigene Gesellschaft in einem exklusiven Gebiet und greift zugleich auf die Methodik, die Werkzeuge und das Wissen des gesamten Netzwerks zu. Wir sind in den Niederlanden, Belgien, Süddeutschland, der Schweiz und Großbritannien tätig und bauen jetzt Nord- und Ostdeutschland auf.

Aufgaben

Ihre Perspektive

  • Regionales Wachstum verantworten: Sie gründen und führen Ihre Beratungsgesellschaft unter der Marke thexton armstrong mit exklusiven Rechte für ein Gebiet in Nord- oder Ostdeutschland.
  • Unternehmen im Mittelstand voranbringen: Sie helfen Unternehmern versickerte Gewinne zu lokalisieren und in ins Unternehmen zurückzuführen. Mithilfe der proprietären thexton armstrong Programme befähigen Sie Unternehmer und Ihre Teams dauerhaft Wachstum, Ergebnis und Unternehmenswert zu steigern und Strukturen zu verbessern.
  • Vom Projektgeschäft zum Mandantenstamm: Ihre Mandanten arbeiten mit Ihnen über monatliche Retainer statt Tagessätze, in der Regel über zwölf Monate und oft über Jahre. Mit fünf bis zehn Mandanten parallel entsteht eine Auslastung, die nicht mit jedem Projektende neu beginnt.
  • Strukturiert akquirieren: Sie gewinnen Mandanten weiterhin selbst, aber mit einem erprobten Einstieg über Discovery-Gespräch und Test zur Gewinnversickerung statt offener Angebotspräsentationen. Dazu bauen Sie ein Empfehlungsnetzwerk aus Steuerberatern, Banken und anderen Partnern auf.
  • Das Gesicht der Marke in Ihrer Region sein: Sie vertreten thexton armstrong gegenüber Unternehmern, Verbänden und Multiplikatoren und gestalten Marketing und Veranstaltungen gemeinsam mit der Regionalorganisation.
  • International zusammenarbeiten: Sie tauschen sich mit Partnern in fünf Ländern über Mandate, Methoden und Erfahrungen aus.

Qualifikation

Ihr Hintergrund

  • Sie sind seit mehreren Jahren als Interim Manager, Unternehmensberater oder Beirat für mittelständische Unternehmen tätig und haben davor selbst Führungs- und Ergebnisverantwortung getragen.
  • Sie haben mit Inhabern und ihren Führungsteams gearbeitet, nicht nur mit Fachabteilungen in Konzernen.
  • Sie akquirieren selbst und wollen das mit einem strukturierten Verfahren weiter tun.
  • Sie sind bereit, sich auf gemeinsame Standards, eine gemeinsame Marke und ein gemeinsames Reporting einzulassen.

Ihre Kompetenzen und Ihre Haltung

  • strategisches und kaufmännisches Urteilsvermögen
  • unternehmerischer Anspruch mit langfristiger Perspektive
  • die Fähigkeit, mit Geschäftsführern und Inhabern Beziehungen aufzubauen und Vertrauen zu gewinnen
  • unabhängig, belastbar, an Ergebnissen orientiert, pragmatisch und authentisch
  • Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (Pflicht), gutes Englisch und Wohnsitz in Nord- oder Ostdeutschland
  • finanziell in der Lage, eine Anlaufphase zu überbrücken und den Ausbau des eigenen Geschäfts zu tragen

Benefits

Warum mit thexton armstrong?

  • Erprobtes System: mehr als ein Jahrzehnt Erfahrung mit messbaren Ergebnissen für Mandanten und Partner. Der Erfolg jedes Mandats wird am realisierten Betrag gegenüber dem im Test festgestellten Betrag gemessen.
  • Schlüsselfertiges Geschäftsmodell: Einarbeitung in zehn Workshoptagen über zwei Monate, Methodik, Online-Werkzeuge, Vorlagen und ein Startprogramm für die Mandantengewinnung. Sie entwickeln Ihr Angebot nicht mehr allein weiter.
  • Unterstützung bei der Lead-Generierung: In der Startphase unterstützen wir Sie bei der Gewinnung von Erstkontakten zu Geschäftsinhabern, damit Sie schneller zu ersten Gesprächen kommen und Ihr Mandantenstamm zügiger wächst.
  • Geringe Fixkosten, hohe Autonomie: Sie arbeiten vom Homeoffice oder einem Regionalbüro aus, ohne Personal zu Beginn, und entscheiden selbst über Tempo und Umfang des Ausbaus.
  • Begleitung und Kollegenkreis: laufende Begleitung durch die Regionalverantwortlichen und ein internationales Netzwerk von Partnern mit vergleichbarem Hintergrund.
  • Exklusives Gebiet: Ihr Gebiet ist Ihnen exklusiv zugeordnet; Sie bauen darin Ihren eigenen Mandantenstamm und Ihr eigenes Netzwerk auf. Aktiv akquirieren Sie in Ihrem Gebiet; Mandanten von außerhalb, die von sich aus auf Sie zukommen, dürfen Sie ebenfalls betreuen.
  • Arbeit mit Wirkung: Sie sorgen dafür, dass Geschäftsinhaber ihre Unternehmen ertragsstärker und widerstandsfähiger führen und dabei selbst mehr Freiheit gewinnen.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Sie arbeiten als Unternehmer. Es handelt sich nicht um eine sozialversicherungspflichtige Anstellung.
  • Der Aufbau des Mandantenstamms ist Ihre Aufgabe. Im ersten Jahr steht die Gewinnung von Mandanten im Vordergrund; dafür erhalten Sie ein erprobtes Verfahren, laufende Begleitung und Unterstützung bei der Lead-Generierung. Die Einnahmen bauen sich in dieser Phase auf.
  • Wie bestehende Mandate in der Übergangszeit behandelt werden, besprechen wir im Erstgespräch.
  • Die wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen der Partnerschaft legen wir Ihnen im Erstgespräch vollständig offen. Zusagen zu Einkommen geben wir nicht.

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft des Mittelstands in Nord- und Ostdeutschland mit.

Dies ist mehr als eine Position: Es ist eine unternehmerische Führungsaufgabe mit Wachstumsperspektive für Berater, die ihre Erfahrung mit einem System und einem Kollegenkreis verbinden und im Mittelstand ihrer Region etwas bewegen wollen.

Auswahl und Kontakt

Der Weg zu einer Entscheidung führt über ein vertrauliches Erstgespräch (online, 30 bis 45 Minuten), eine Informationsveranstaltung, Gespräche mit bestehenden Partnern und eine Bedenkzeit vor der Unterschrift.Bewerben Sie sich mit Lebenslauf und einem kurzen Motivationsschreiben bei Christian von Volkmann, Managing Partner thexton armstrong Nord- und Ostdeutschland.

title: Produktdesigner / Industriedesigner (m/d/w) - Home & Living
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Sayano Deutschland GmbH
description_html:
Wir sind Sayano — ein deutsches E-Commerce-Unternehmen, gegründet 2016 in Stuttgart. Unsere Marken MIAMIO, Calmado und Tortillada werden in über 80 Ländern vertrieben — über unseren eigenen Onlineshop, sowie Amazon, Otto und weitere Marktplätze. Wir vereinen die komplette vertikale Wertschöpfungskette vom Design, der Entwicklung, der Produktion, sowie dem Vertrieb und Kundenservice von Produkten im Bereich Küche, Haushalt und Spielzeug.

Als gestalterische Handschrift unserer Marken verantwortest du unsere Produkte von der ersten Skizze bis zur Serienfreigabe — Form, Material, Farbe und Funktion. Weil wir selbst entwickeln und produzieren, landen deine Entwürfe nicht in der Schublade: Sie stehen wenige Monate später in Haushalten weltweit.

Aufgaben

  • Konzeption & Entwurf: Du entwickelst innovative Produktdesigns — schwerpunktmäßig für unsere Brand MIAMIO — und begleitest sie von der Konzeption, über die Detaillierung und Ausarbeitung in 3D, bis hin zur Freigabe des serienreifen Prototypen.
  • 3D-Modeling & Visualisierung: Du gestaltest detaillierte 3D-Modelle in CAD (vorzugsweise Blender) und erstellst daraus fotorealistische Renderings. KI-Tools nutzt du dabei selbstverständlich als Teil deines Workflows — für erste Konzeptvarianten, Moodboards und realistische Visualisierungen.
  • 2D-Design: Du bringst Ideen schnell von Hand aufs Papier und illustrierst Dekore und Patterns eigenständig, die du bis zur serienreifen Print Datei für den Hersteller ausarbeitest.
  • Briefings & technische Spezifikationen: Du erstellst Briefingunterlagen und technische Spezifikationen inklusive technischer Zeichnungen. Zudem definierst du Dekore, Glasuren, Farbwelten und Oberflächen.
  • Machbarkeit & Zielkosten: Du denkst Materialien, Fertigungsverfahren, Toleranzen und Zielkosten von Anfang an mit — inklusive Verpackungsmaß und Versandfähigkeit im Onlinehandel. Dabei bist du stets in enger Abstimmung mit deinen Teamkollegen aus dem Produktmanagement und dem Sourcing Team.
  • Design- & Trendresearch: Du erstellst Vision-Moodboards, screenst laufend Trends, Materialinnovationen und Wettbewerber.

Nice to have:

  • Verpackungsdesign: Du gestaltest ansprechende 2D Packaging Designs auf Basis der Dielines unserer Produktionspartner — inklusive druckfertiger Daten.
  • Branding & Grafikdesign: Du unterstützt in der Markenkommunikation und bist in der Lage, Aufgaben im Bereich Grafikdesign, Brand Strategie und Fotografie zu übernehmen.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium: Im Bereich Produktdesign, Produktgestaltung, Industriedesign oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang. Erste Berufserfahrung wünschenswert, vorzugsweise im Bereich Consumer Goods oder Interiordesign.
  • 3D-Software: Sicherer Umgang mit CAD-Software, vorzugsweise in Blender, Rhino oder Cinema 4D, sowie die Erstellung von fotorealistischen Renderings oder AI generierten Images
  • Adobe Cloud: Sicherer Umgang in Adobe Photoshop und Adobe Illustrator.
  • Design & Trends: Ein hohes Maß an Kreativität, ein sehr gutes Auge für Ästhetik und ein Gespür für Trends (primär im Home/Living/Interior Bereich), die unsere Zielgruppe begeistern.
  • Material- & Fertigungsverständnis: Ein gutes Verständnis für Materialien wie Keramik, Porzellan, Glas, Metall oder Holz und deren Fertigungsverfahren — oder die Neugier, sich schnell einzuarbeiten.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Strukturiertes, selbstständiges Arbeiten, hohe Eigenmotivation und Hands-on-Mentalität.
  • Deutsch & Englisch: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits
