title: Robotics Engineer - Freelance (Mid-Level / Senior)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at RoboService GmbH
description_html:
RoboService solves the "Last Mile" of humanoid robotics. While manufacturers provide the hardware and foundation models, these general-purpose "brains" are not yet ready for the specific, accurate tasks of a production line. We bridge that gap.

We build a stack that is "AI Enabled", but provides safety and reliability through deterministic orchestration.

We are not a research lab; we are shipping code that moves atoms. Launched in July 2025 by repeat founders with successful exits, we are looking for engineers who want to take robots out of the lab and onto the factory floor.

Tasks

We are looking for a Senior Robotics Engineer to build fully autonomous robots. Our tech stack provides a large part of the infrastructure and core components to build reliable automations with Humanoids.

However, each project needs customizations. Your task will be to adjust our tech stack to the specific use case you are working on. Additionally, you will be further enhancing and extending our tech stack.

You won't be writing papers. You will be working on:

  • ROS 2 Development: Develop and integrate ROS 2 packages to enable reliable communication, control, and coordination across robotic systems.
  • Data Pipeline & Imitation Learning: Manage the data pipeline and oversee teleoperation and imitation-learning activities to ensure high-quality training data. Manage large datasets required for model fine-tuning.
  • Reinforcement Learning (RL): Apply RL techniques to fine-tune robot actions, ensuring robust performance on the production line.
  • Simulation & Sim-to-Real: Use high-fidelity simulation environments such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Omniverse to train and test agents before deploying them to physical hardware.

Requirements

  • Education: BS / MS in Robotics OR equivalent robotics experience.
  • Experience: 3-5+ years of hands-on experience in robotics, deep learning, or embodied AI.
  • Robotics Middleware: Familiarity with ROS2 (Robot Operating System), including navigation, manipulation, and driver integration.
  • Core ML Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX). Experience with Transformers and VLA architectures is highly desirable.
  • Simulation: Some experience with physics-based simulators, specifically NVIDIA Isaac Sim or similar (Gazebo, MuJoCo).
  • Data Engineering: Ability to manage high quality demonstration datasets, automate data cleaning, and build training pipelines.
  • Pioneering: Experience debugging hardware/software interfaces on non-standard platforms.
  • Strong in Python (C++ is a +)
  • Proficiency in English

Benefits

  • Above market salary
  • Access to Cutting Edge Tech: Work daily on the latest software and hardware that will shape our future.
  • Impact: Work in real projects with manufacturers to bring robots onto manufacturing floors.
  • Startup Environment: We are a fast-moving startup with high growth ambitions.
  • Team of Experts: We are a team of experts where every voice matters. Work with professionals that are leading their field.

title: Account Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at BLUE Communications
description_html:
BLUE is a specialist global B2B communications consultancy for organisations operating in complex, high-value industries - such as maritime, marine leisure, energy and carbon markets. Since 2008, we've turned market expertise into influence and impact, helping clients lead conversations, shape markets and unlock growth.

Our credibility comes from deep immersion, not observation. We get close enough to our clients' businesses to understand what motivates them, and what keeps them awake at night, so we can operate as true consultants, not just a delivery team. It's why our clients stay, and why we've built long-term partnerships across some of the most complex, high-value industries there are.

The role

We're looking for an Account Manager to become the established day-to-day ‘go-to' for a portfolio of clients, trusted for the quality of your judgement as much as the quality of your delivery. You'll translate agreed strategy into sharp, on-brief tactical implementation, combine PR creativity with sector intelligence to spot the angles that matter, and mentor the Account Executives coming up behind you.

It's a role for someone who wants to be a genuine communications counsel to their clients, a ‘critical friend' who steers activity, not just executes it, while helping to shape BLUE's culture and the next generation of BLUE talent.

Tasks

Client & account management

  • Become the trusted day-to-day contact for your clients, translating agreed strategy into sharp tactical delivery across multiple accounts
  • Monitor delivery against KPIs, combining PR creativity with sector knowledge to spot news hooks and thought leadership angles
  • Act as a ‘critical friend', leading client meetings and building relationships with journalists and industry influencers

Writing & content

  • Produce client-ready first drafts, press releases, pitches, by-lined features, media briefs and speaker abstracts, with minimal input needed from senior colleagues
  • Oversee client social media content across social media, keeping tone of voice on-brand for every client

Team & culture

  • Mentor and develop Account Executives, helping them build their skills and realise their potential as PR professionals
  • Delegate effectively, draft in senior support where needed, and manage upwards to keep every deadline on track
  • Act as a custodian of BLUE's culture, setting the standard for those coming up behind you

Events & business growth

  • Own the delivery of client events and webinars against agreed KPIs, from invitation lists and venue liaison to budgets and on-the-day delivery
  • Spot commercial opportunities within your accounts and flag them to the senior team
  • Contribute to new business pitches, proposals and brainstorms, and help build BLUE's own profile and network

Requirements

Essential

  • Solid agency-side PR or communications experience, with a track record of managing client accounts day-to-day
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with strict attention to grammar, tone and journalistic style
  • Proven project management skills, the ability to juggle multiple accounts, prioritise, and manage deadlines (including upwards)
  • Experience mentoring or line-managing junior team members
  • Strong media relations skills, with existing relationships with journalists and industry influencers
  • A commercial mindset, with the confidence to push back and manage client expectations against an agreed retainer

Desirable

  • Experience in, or genuine curiosity about, the marine, renewable energy or wider sustainability sectors
  • Experience managing client events or webinars
  • Experience managing social media for corporate or B2B clients

Benefits

  • Hybrid working, with a 4pm Friday finish encouraged
  • Dog friendly offices
  • A charity donation made in your name on your birthday and the day off
  • Employee of the Quarter recognition
  • Additional annual leave after 2 years
  • New Business commission scheme
  • Employee assistance scheme
  • Two centrally located UK offices, fully stocked with food and drink
  • Regular team socials, from dragon boat racing to scavenger hunts
  • Perk Box access and discounts
  • Salary sacrifice pension scheme
  • ‘Work from anywhere’ policy (2 weeks, after 1 year of service)
  • A genuine stake in a growing, purpose-led consultancy
  • Opportunity for international travel and events
  • Weekly T@3 for knowledge sharing
  • Loyalty bonuses

If you're interested in applying for the role and joining our team at BLUE, please send your most recent CV by email with the subject heading 'Account Manager' to our careers inbox at Be sure to include an introduction explaining why you're applying for the role and we'll respond to you as soon as we can!

title: Account Executive at United Media

description_html:
Are you someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, where you are given the autonomy and support to handle large amounts of responsibility?

Are you looking for the opportunity to accelerate your sales career whilst also being surrounded by an exceptional entrepreneurial team with motivated and extremely driven people?

About us

United Media focuses on building large-scale industry media and conference products across sectors such as private equity, insurance, HR, retail and finance. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one, including Private Equity Insights, Insurtech Insights, Presidents Summit, HRtechX, CFO Insights, Retail Insights and SetSales.

We bring together thousands of executives, investors, founders and industry leaders at our conferences around the world, creating opportunities for people to learn, connect and build meaningful business relationships.

What we offer you

You will be a key player in helping to build the greatest global conferences. We will ensure that you are given both the training and tools to succeed in the role and drive you to continue to push yourself in order to maximise your career development. You'll be based out of our HQ in London where you will have the opportunity to interact with people at all levels across the business. We will offer you the following:

  • A competitive salary and market leading OTE.

  • An opportunity for getting operational experience in a scale-up business where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matters to the businesses.

  • A chance to work closely with our senior leadership team on conference strategies.

  • International travel to our conferences.

  • Unlimited growth potential in our group - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.

Your Responsibilities

Your mission is to own the full sales cycle in selling high-value conference sponsorships to senior prospects. In order to be successful, your main duties will include:

  • Build new business revenue: Deliver credible, professional sales pitches to new prospects in order to achieve ambitious sales targets.

  • Pipeline development: Work with our marketing and analyst team to source, contact and set up meetings with potential sponsors.

  • Establish client relationships: Work closely with our content and delivery teams to ensure best-in-class delivery.

  • Leverage our expertise: Work hand-in-hand with our content team to create compelling pitches to inspire our prospects.

What we expect from you

You possess a strong work ethic with a high sense of urgency, and you have both the drive and desire to be the very best at what you do. You take ownership of everything you do, along with having a growth mindset constantly looking for areas to improve. Moreover, you share our passion for building and executing new businesses. We expect that you can demonstrate:

  • Sales excellence: At least 2 years of B2B sales experience and evidence of regularly outperforming targets.

  • Drive & Passion: Evidence of a passion for sales and business development.

  • Team Spirit: Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations.

  • Communication Maestro: Showcase stellar verbal and written communication skills.

  • Pride in Work: Uphold the highest standards, ensuring every task you undertake is a testament to quality.

Start date: As soon as possible.

Monday–Friday, we work from our WeWork office in Victoria, London. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, we do not offer remote work.

You must have the right to work in the UK.

title: Senior National Account Manager - Industry & Manufacturing
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Flora Food Group
description_html:
The Practical Detail
Location: Southwark, London
Working Model: Hybrid

Why this role matters
In your first year, you will lead the commercial growth of Flora Professional's Industry & Manufacturing business across the UK and Ireland, driving sustainable revenue growth and securing new strategic partnerships. This role is vital to expanding Flora's presence in key sectors such as bakery, desserts, soups, sauces, and beverages. By combining commercial expertise with culinary innovation, you will help manufacturers create exceptional food products that meet evolving consumer needs. Your work will directly support Flora Food Group's mission to deliver better food solutions that inspire kitchens and delight consumers.

What you'll do

  • Lead the execution of Flora Professional's growth strategy across Industry & Manufacturing sectors, identifying new commercial opportunities.
  • Build and maintain trusted partnerships with procurement, commercial, technical, and culinary stakeholders at leading food manufacturers.
  • Collaborate with Culinary, Marketing, Technical, and R&D teams to develop innovative recipes and product applications that showcase Flora's portfolio.
  • Drive commercial excellence through negotiations, joint business planning, pricing discussions, and long-term agreements.
  • Manage and coach a Junior Key Account Manager, fostering a culture of accountability and high performance.

Performance
You will own the commercial growth of a key business area generating over 45% gross margin in the UK channel. Your data-driven approach and commercial insight will ensure sustainable revenue growth, improved customer engagement, and operational excellence. Success will be measured by your ability to meet growth targets, secure new partnerships, and maintain strong sales performance.

Care
This role reports to senior leadership and includes line management of a Junior Key Account Manager. You will work closely across functions including Marketing, Technical, R&D, Culinary, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure aligned and sustainable commercial execution. Your decisions will balance short-term results with long-term partnerships and responsible business practices that build lasting value for Flora and its customers.

Passion
You are a food lover and innovator who thrives on combining commercial success with culinary creativity. Your curiosity about taste, nutrition, functionality, and reliability drives you to help customers develop exceptional products that stand out in the market. You take pride in contributing to Flora Food Group's future-focused approach to better food, inspiring kitchens and consumers alike.

About you
You bring proven experience managing strategic B2B accounts within Foodservice, FMCG, or Industry & Manufacturing, with a strong track record of growing long-term commercial opportunities. You understand the complexity of manufacturing customers and excel at building trusted partnerships. Your commercial acumen is demonstrated through leading negotiations, pricing, and joint business planning. You communicate effectively, influence stakeholders, and work cross-functionally with diverse teams. Your entrepreneurial mindset, resilience, and curiosity help you identify new opportunities and challenge the status quo.

You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences.

Where this could lead to
This role typically leads to senior commercial leadership positions within Flora Professional or broader commercial roles across the business. Over time, you can expect to take on greater responsibility for shaping strategy and leading larger teams, influencing Flora Food Group's growth across multiple markets.

What's next
If this opportunity sounds exciting, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Catapult Sports
description_html:
Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT PLATFORM ENGINEERING

We are looking for a talented and inquisitive Senior DevOps Engineer whose drive for learning and determination for continuous improvement aligns with our ambitious, fast-growing and transforming company. Based in our London office, you will be a key player in planning, designing, building and testing the features of our next-generation cloud platform that combines digital video assets, wearable data and athlete information to provide insights and analytics to coaching/support staff, sports scientists and athletes to assist in optimizing athlete performance. We believe that our customers deserve the best platform and we are on a mission to maximize and enhance their performance through delivering a high-quality experience. Our software and DevOps engineers match this ethos by taking responsibility for constantly improving productivity and development of self and be able to excel in a fast-paced environment with short project timelines from conception to deployment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Cloud & Platform Engineering
    • Infrastructure Automation & IaC: Own infrastructure provisioning and configuration management (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
    • Observability & Reliability: Design, build and maintain logging, monitoring, alerting, and SLO/SLI frameworks to ensure system health and performance.
    • Software Delivery Pipelines: Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, safe, and repeatable software delivery.
    • Infrastructure Operations & Governance: Oversee the availability, scalability, and performance of cloud and on-prem infrastructure while ensuring all systems remain strictly aligned with corporate security standards and global regulatory compliance.
  • Cloud Security 
    • Cloud Security & Compliance: Ensure compliance with relevant compliance and regulatory frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR as applicable) and implement best practices cloud security controls.
    • Security Operation: Lead security first approach, collaborate with Security and IT teams to make sure our infrastructure is patched according to SLAs.
    • Application Security (AppSec): Collaborate with security teams to embed security controls into CI/CD pipelines and platform services.
  • Technology leader
    • Architectural Roadmap & Vision: Define and execute the long-term technical roadmap for Catapult's global cloud platform, evaluating emerging technologies (e.g., Serverless, AI-driven operations, and Containerization) to ensure the infrastructure remains cutting-edge, scalable, and best to used by our customers.
    • Technical Governance & Standards: Be a big contribution to  infrastructure decisions, establishing "Golden Paths" and reusable Infrastructure as Code patterns that dictate how engineering teams deploy services while ensuring consistency across all environments.
    • Strategic Security & Compliance Integration: Architect and champion a "Shift-Left" security strategy, mandating the integration of automated security guardrails and compliance auditing into the core fabric of the CI/CD pipelines to protect athlete and video data globally.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Significant experience in DevOps, Site Reliability, Platform or Infrastructure Engineering, with tenure in technical leadership role.
  • Deep expertise in the AWS cloud platform and associated security and compliance practices.
  • Strong background in infrastructure automation (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.
  • Proven experience with big platform re-design, architecture of new cloud infrastructure systems based on software and business requirements.
  • Solid understanding of AppSec principles, including integrating security into build and deploy pipelines.
  • Experience managing hybrid environments, including traditional data centers and on-prem services.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to influence across engineering, security, and finance.
  • Experience with regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, fintech).
  • Familiarity with multiple compliance frameworks (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS).

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

In 6 months time…

By the half-year mark, you will have moved beyond the onboarding phase to become the primary authority on Catapult's infrastructure.

  • Infrastructure Ownership: You will fully own the cloud infrastructure, having gained a deep understanding of all interconnected parts that support their athlete and video data services.
  • Established Automation: You will have taken control of infrastructure provisioning and configuration management, ensuring that Terraform or Ansible are being used effectively for IaC.
  • Observability Implementation: You will have designed and begun maintaining essential logging, monitoring, and SLO/SLI frameworks to ensure high system health and performance.
  • Have a full understanding of Catapult's products and the way we are working in order to be able to architect any new future existing or new product.

In 12 months time…

By the end of your first year, you will be driving the "next generation" of Catapult's technology stack and leading cross-functional improvements.

  • End to End Platform Ownership: You will take full accountability for the evolution of our production ecosystem, architecting a resilient, "deploy-anywhere" infrastructure that scales seamlessly with software demands and business growth.
  • Optimized Delivery: You will have refined the CI/CD pipelines to a state where software delivery is consistently fast, safe, and repeatable across the engineering team.
  • Integrated Security and Compliance: You will have transitioned the platform to a "security-first" architecture, successfully embedding automated AppSec controls and vulnerability scanning directly into the CI/CD pipelines.
  • Cross-Departmental Influence: Your success will be reflected in your ability to influence stakeholders across engineering, security, and finance to drive technical and operational improvements.

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious,  intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. 
  • We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.  
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve.  There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Finance team shapes the company's future by directing capital to high-impact investments, developing robust financial strategies, and ensuring we deliver long-term value while pursuing our ambitious mission.

We're looking for a Senior Finance Manager to join our London team. In this role, you'll lead key aspects of the reporting and accounting process, ensuring our financial operations remain robust and scalable.

Get to know our Finance team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Europe Accounting team. This team acts as the engine room for our financial integrity, bridging the gap between local operations and global reporting standards during an exciting period of integration.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Drive Reporting Excellence: Lead month-end and quarter-end close activities, ensuring all financial reporting deliverables are accurate, timely, and aligned with US headquarters requirements.

  • Operational Oversight: Oversee the review of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and variance analysis to maintain the highest standards of financial accuracy.

  • Process Transformation: Identify process gaps and implement scalable controls to strengthen financial governance and shorten close cycles across Europe.

  • Strategic Partnering: Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders in Operations and regional teams to streamline accounting workflows and improve data quality.

  • Audit & Compliance: Coordinate internal and external audit requests while maintaining comprehensive documentation for key accounting processes and SOPs.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Professional Qualification: ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent accountancy qualification with at least 4 years of post-qualified experience.

  • Technical Depth: Significant post-qualification experience within a complex, fast-paced financial environment, ideally with a focus on group reporting.

  • System Proficiency: Strong understanding of NetSuite (or equivalent ERP systems) and financial reporting tools.

  • Stakeholder Influence: Proven ability to partner with cross-functional teams and influence senior leaders across different regions and functions.

  • Adaptability: A proactive mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity and drive outcomes in an evolving global business environment.

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

Du arbeitest in interdisziplinären Projektteams und unterstützt unsere Kund:innen dabei, die Implementierung von Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & SCM zur Erfolgsstory zu machen. Unsere Projekte sind vielfältig und betreffen Kund:innen aus unterschiedlichen Branchen. Du arbeitest mit Projektteams und Expert:innen aus verschiedenen Bereichen zusammen, um End to End Prozesse zu definieren und Dienstleistungen auf Basis fundierter technischer und fachlicher Expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 bereitzustellen.

Mithilfe etablierter Methoden sorgst Du für eine transparente Darstellung von Prozessen, Aufgaben und Strukturen im gesamten Projekt. Du bleibst am Puls der Zeit, indem Du dich kontinuierlich weiterbildest, neue Projekte umsetzt und in einem internationalen Umfeld mit vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten arbeitest. title: Senior Backend Engineer (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at TYTAN Technologies GmbH
description_html:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We thrive, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who thrive on ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

We are looking for a new team member who is eager to make a real difference! As a Senior Full-Stack Developer, you will be responsible for designing and developing scalable military ground control station applications coordinating various effectors and integrating with external systems in real-time mission-critical environments.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • Own the backend and integration layer for ground systems the services connecting operator tools, vehicles, sensors, and mission infrastructure

  • Design event-driven architectures and durable interface contracts so frontend, embedded, and partner systems can integrate and evolve safely

  • Build software that holds up in real operations, from telemetry pipelines to deployment, and follow problems across service boundaries end to end (including occasional lab or field support)

  • Raise engineering standards through design, code review, and mentoring, working closely with frontend, embedded, and guidance/navigation/control engineers


We care more about strong software engineers than checkbox perfection. If you meet most of these and are motivated to grow into the rest, please still apply tell us where you are strong and where you would ramp up.

Technical skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience, plus 5+ years of commercial backend/platform development (no mission-domain background required)

  • Strong Python skills, it's the primary language for integration work on this team

  • Experience with service design, event-driven systems, async messaging, and evolving APIs without breaking consumers

  • Hands-on experience with contract-first interfaces: OpenAPI and Protocol Buffers

  • Track record building production APIs and real-time channels (REST, WebSockets, pub-sub)

  • Practical understanding of latency and performance trade-offs in system design

  • Comfortable with PostgreSQL, Redis, and choosing the right tool for the workload

  • Experience on Linux with Docker and CI/CD, with a solid grasp of HTTP servers and reverse proxies

  • Hands-on observability skills: structured logging, metrics, and production experience with Prometheus/Grafana

Soft Skills

  • Comfortable working in Scrum or similar agile teams

  • Strong software craftsmanship: testing, debugging distributed issues, code review, and clear communication in English (German a plus)

  • Ownership mindset, you follow problems across service boundaries and take responsibility for making integrations work end to end

Nice to Have

  • ROS 2 experience (nodes, topics, services) and familiarity with DDS/QoS

  • Deeper networking knowledge (TCP/IP, UDP, sockets) or hands-on work with Nginx/HAProxy

  • Time-series databases (e.g. InfluxDB) for high-frequency telemetry

  • Additional languages such as TypeScript/Node, Go, or C++

  • Familiarity with MAVLink or similar vehicle/telemetry protocols

  • Prior work in robotics, autonomous systems, defense, or industrial control software

  • Tech-lead or mentoring experience

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for on-site integration and test campaigns

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation

  • Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

  • Work directly with the engineers, operators and test teams who use your software, and translate their day-to-day problems into simple, durable solutions

title: Working Student Software Engineering (m/f/d)

description_html:
Are you a Bachelor’s or Master’s student in the Rhein-Main area who is passionate about shaping the financial world of tomorrow and eager to level up your skills by working on real projects in a modern FinTech environment?

Then Ginmon is the right place for you!

We are an innovative FinTech company focused on digital wealth management based on scientifically proven ETF investment strategies. Our technical platform provides private investors, partner banks and financial institutions with efficient, transparent and professional access to asset management.

Driven by our growth ambitions and supported by an international team of financial experts, tech enthusiasts, and startup pioneers, we share one common mission: helping our clients achieve their financial goals efficiently, transparently, and scientifically.

As a Working Student in Software Engineering (m/f/d), you bring curiosity, initiative, and a strong sense of responsibility to contribute to the financial technologies of tomorrow.

Responsibilities:

  • Actively contribute to the Ginmon codebase and deliver real value to our users through clean, scalable, and well-tested code;

  • Support backend components of our automated asset management solution;

  • Enforce best practices by communicating with team members and holding each other accountable;

  • Support the teams developing the products and services built on the shared infrastructure.


Your Profile:

  • You are currently enrolled as a Bachelor’s or Master’s student at a university in the Rhein-Main area, with at least two semesters remaining before graduation, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business Informatics, or a related field;

  • Knowledge in programming. Ideally, you already have knowledge of one or more of the following technologies or tools: AWS Lambda / Quarqus / JOOQ / MySQL;

  • You are eager to gain real-world insights into entrepreneurial practice and actively contribute to innovative digital solutions;

  • You have good communication skills and are fluent in English;

  • Ideally, you are based near Frankfurt am Main, as occasional on-site collaboration with the Product Development team is required.

Why Ginmon?

  • With us, you can bring about change directly and realise your ideas in a flat hierarchy. Your input counts and you have the opportunity to put your ideas into practice.

  • With a lot of responsibility and a steep learning curve, we have already helped many working students get off to a good start in their careers. You will be entrusted with challenging tasks and experience rapid development.

  • Working at Ginmon means having fun and being successful at the same time. We promote a positive working environment where fun and success go hand in hand.

  • You will benefit from our market-leading product that offers real added value to our customers. Our innovative solutions help investors achieve their financial goals efficiently.

  • Enjoy a relaxed working atmosphere with free drinks, snacks and regular team events.

  • We offer special employee conditions and a variety of other attractive benefits.


    Do you want to join our team? Then apply now and actively shape the future of the financial world!

title: Account Executive (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Bliq
description_html:
Your mission

At Bliq, we are building and launching driverless vehicles for everyday life and business operations across Europe.

We are looking for a Account Executive to help bring them to customers.

You will acquire business and individual customers across European markets and own the commercial process end-to-end: identify and engage prospects, run discovery, demonstrate the product in person, design the right commercial and operating model for each customer, build proposals, negotiate, and close.

Our customers can look very different. One week, you may be discussing a fleet deployment with a taxi or car-sharing company. The next, you may be showing the vehicle to a real-estate company, law firm, mobility operator, or prospective individual customer.

This is not a role where you inherit a mature market, established category, and optimized sales playbook. Driverless technology is only getting started in Europe. You will need to understand unfamiliar customer problems quickly, figure out how Bliq can solve them, and help us discover how this technology should be sold.

You will work closely with the Commercial Lead and founders to refine Bliq’s sales playbook market by market.

Responsibilities

  • Own the sales cycle from first conversation through signed contract

  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound and proactive prospecting across European markets

  • Run sharp discovery conversations that uncover customer operations, economics, pain points, and decision criteria

  • Conduct live Bliq vehicle demos and turn the experience into a compelling commercial conversation

  • Develop deployment concepts together with prospects, including use case, fleet size, operating model, responsibilities, economics, and rollout plan

  • Create proposals, commercial models, LOIs, and contracts together with the relevant internal teams

  • Navigate complex buying processes involving operators, management teams, fleet owners, partners, and other stakeholders

  • Build relationships with customers across mobility, taxi, car sharing, rental, real estate, professional services, and other relevant sectors

  • Own defined markets and be accountable for commercial progress within them

  • Keep CRM data, pipeline, next steps, and forecasts accurate

  • Test new segments, messages, channels, and commercial models and turn what works into repeatable processes

  • Work closely with the Customer Deployment team to make sure signed customers can actually be deployed successfully

  • Represent Bliq at customer meetings, industry events, demos, and market visits across Europe

  • Support B2C sales initiatives when they become part of the GTM strategy

  • Bring customer feedback directly into Bliq’s product, operations, and commercial decisions



Your profile

Apply if this describes you:

  • You have at least 2 years of Account Executive or comparable full-cycle sales experience

  • You are a hunter and enjoy creating opportunities rather than waiting for inbound demand

  • You learn quickly and can become credible on a complex technical product without hiding behind technical jargon

  • You are excellent face-to-face and comfortable walking into an important customer meeting, running the room, and demonstrating a physical product

  • You are customer-first and care about finding solutions that make customers satisfied

  • You have strong commercial judgment and understand how to turn customer needs into a viable deal

  • You write clearly and can produce concise, convincing emails, proposals, and commercial documents

  • You are highly organized and detail-oriented; pipeline hygiene, follow-ups, and commitments do not get lost

  • You have CRM experience and understand disciplined sales processes

  • Experience with tools such as Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar is a plus

  • You know how to use AI to research, prepare, analyze, and move faster while keeping the thinking and customer judgment your own

  • You have a figure-it-out mindset and remain effective when there is no existing template for the problem

  • You are comfortable owning a market or commercial project and being measured by the outcome

  • You can work professionally in German and English; additional European languages are a plus

  • You are based in Berlin

  • You are willing to travel regularly across Europe

  • Experience selling hardware, mobility, automotive, physical technology, or other operationally complex products is a strong plus

This role will probably not suit you if you want an established sales process, a narrowly defined territory, a predictable product demo, or a manager telling you exactly what to do next.

It will suit you if you want to help create a category, sell something people can experience in the real world, and build the commercial machine while running it.


Why us?

  • Sell a product people are excited about

  • Build Bliq’s sales playbook together with the Commercial Lead

  • Work directly with the founders and senior team

  • Own meaningful customer relationships and markets from an early stage

  • Work on complex deals combining technology, vehicles, operations, economics, and regulation

  • See deals move from your first message to vehicles operating on public roads with the customer

  • Fast decisions, direct feedback, and no bureaucracy

  • Strong compensation package with meaningful upside for performance

  • Significant room to grow as Bliq expands across European markets

Tips for a successful application

  1. Show us that you can sell. Generic applications tell us very little.

  2. Tell us what you have personally owned and what results you produced.

  3. If you have built pipeline, opened a new market, sold a difficult product, or closed an unusual deal, tell us how.

  4. Use AI as a tool. Make sure the thinking and personality in your application are yours.

title: System Software Engineer (gn) Cloud & Simulation
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Wandelbots GmbH
description_html:
Your mission

At Wandelbots, we are building NOVA, a platform that makes industrial robot programming accessible to everyone. Our Simulation team develops the technologies that allow partners, customers, and internal teams to work with photorealistic digital twins of real production environments.

This includes a pipeline that transforms real-world scans into usable 3D scenes through Gaussian Splatting, as well as a browser-based streaming platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim. Both technologies work today, but neither is yet operated as a product. Your mission is to change that.

The first step is internal standardization. We want to replace individually maintained environments and hand-crafted deployments with one reproducible, documented solution that teams can use independently: scene in, session out, without requiring the Simulation team to operate every setup.
The second step is external productization. The same capabilities need to be packaged so that partners and customers can operate them in their own environments. 
E.g. with versioned releases, stable interfaces, tenant isolation, diagnostics, upgrade paths, and documentation.

You will join the Simulation team and focus on the infrastructure and operational foundations of these systems. You will not be building them in isolation: Wandelbots has an established infrastructure team responsible for shared infrastructure and platform capabilities. You will work closely with that team while owning the simulation-specific workloads, deployment patterns, and operational requirements.

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape architecture and make technical decisions in collaboration with the teams involved.

What you will work on

  • Build and operate the GPU infrastructure required by our simulation workloads, including NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, driver lifecycle, and GPU sharing through MIG or time slicing

  • Work with the infrastructure team to integrate simulation workloads into our shared Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure

  • Make deployments declarative and reproducible using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps, and help consolidate the tooling used across today’s environments

  • Own CI/CD and the container and image lifecycle for CUDA- and NGC-based workloads

  • Design scheduling and autoscaling for two distinct workload profiles: latency-sensitive interactive streaming sessions and compute-intensive Gaussian Splatting jobs

  • Turn the Gaussian Splatting pipeline into a reproducible workflow, from data capture and training to OpenUSD assets

  • Operate and extend our Omniverse and Isaac Sim streaming platform, including Kit App Streaming, session lifecycle, and tenant isolation

  • Establish the platform as an internal standard through self-service workflows, golden paths, templates, onboarding, and documentation

  • Prepare the solution for operation by partners and customers through packaged deployments, versioned releases, upgrade paths, and actionable diagnostics

  • Support deployments across cloud, on-premises, and partner-managed environments

  • Build meaningful observability using metrics, logs, GPU telemetry, and actionable alerting

  • Define the simulation-specific security and access model, including ingress, TURN and STUN for WebRTC, RBAC, secrets management, SSO, and tenant boundaries

  • Work closely with our robotics, product, and platform teams to ensure that the solution supports real development and customer workflows



Your profile

We are looking for an engineer who is interested in how complex systems are built, deployed, and operated, not only in delivering the next application feature.
You should bring:

  • Experience building or operating production systems in platform engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or systems software

  • Practical Kubernetes experience, including resource management, workload scheduling, and debugging distributed systems under load

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and CI/CD, together with the ability to evaluate tools based on the problem rather than a fixed preference

  • Solid knowledge of Linux, containers, and networking

  • Good Python skills for automation, services, and data-processing workflows

  • Experience with GPU workloads, or a strong technical foundation and clear interest in working with drivers, CUDA, and GPU scheduling

  • The ability to turn working technology into a system that other teams can use independently

  • A strong sense of operational ownership, including documentation, diagnostics, maintainability, and reproducibility

  • Very good English; German is a plus


We do not expect candidates to have prior experience with every technology in this description. A strong systems foundation, the ability to learn unfamiliar components, and an interest in this problem space are more important than matching every item. The scope and responsibilities of the role will grow with your experience.


Nice to have

  • Experience turning an internally developed system into a product that can be operated in customer-controlled environments

  • Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Kit SDK, or OpenUSD

  • Experience with Gaussian Splatting, NeRF, photogrammetry, or comparable 3D reconstruction pipelines

  • Knowledge of WebRTC, pixel streaming, or other low-latency video technologies

  • Python, Rust, or Go skills sufficient to contribute to existing services and infrastructure tooling

  • Experience with robotics or simulation, such as ROS 2 or sim-to-real workflows

  • Experience with multi-tenant platforms, air-gapped deployments, or customer environments with specific security and compliance requirements



Why us?

Make an impact!
Work on an innovative, deep tech product that adds value to the robotics world and to society! Become a crucial part of something new, big and exciting where you can truly make an impact!

Our teams inspire!
Cross-functional communication is key. You'll get to know many of your 100+ colleagues. Collaborate with great people on our international teams who value knowledge sharing and unique ways of doing things!

Be authentic!
Work in a value-driven environment where everything may not be perfect, but we're working on it! Your feedback is required while you receive feedback and appreciation for your work!

Help others!
You can have up to 3 days of volunteer time off to help your favorite charity.

Develop yourself!
We offer training and mental health opportunities so that you can develop both mentally and professionally.

And there is even more!
Enjoy our free lunch, snacks and drinks, team events, 30 days of annual vacation + additional rest during Christmas season until New Year. If your child gets sick, we assure that a 100% of your usual earnings will be paid while you take care of your little one.

Description:

Looking for an employer you can count on? Join us!

 

Data Platform Engineer (f/m/d) for the European AI Factory HammerHAI


Your Role and Responsibilities:

  • Developing and maintaining the data facility of the AI Factory including its software environments in the context of AI, HPC and data analytics use cases for modern AI, high-performance and cloud computing systems
  • Contributing to the initial (and evolving) service portfolio of the AI Factory within a friendly and open work environment in a highly motivated, international team with opportunities to contribute with your own ideas
  • Supporting and enabling customers to publish, access and share their own AI data sets and models
  • Fostering contact with collaboration partners as well as stakeholders from the European AI ecosystem, relying on your friendly personality and communication skills
  • Opportunities to work with national and European partners on novel AI R&D projects from the private and academic sectors
  • Maintaining relationships with technology providers and system developers (software/hardware)


Your Qualifications:

Required/Minimum Qualifications

 

  • PhD or Master’s degree in computer or data science, or other areas of scientific computing, or a Bachelor’s degree with multiple years (>3) of applied data platform development / engineering / deployment experience and/or working with AI data management workflows ideally as senior engineer in research or enterprise environments 

 

Other Requirements

  • Proficiency working in data center environments (incl. Linux, Git, Gitlab)
  • Willingness to keep up with current developments and to learn new technologies in the field of AI
  • Extensive knowledge and experience in developing and working with data platforms including their backend components in the context of AI, HPC and data analytics use cases (preferably piveau, www.piveau.de)
  • Extensive knowledge about and practical skills in specifying and implementing FAIR-aligned (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) data management workflows
  • Knowledge and experience in developing integration layers for connecting data infrastructure with external data platforms, preferably through metadata standards
  • Knowledge about and practical skills in secure and compliant data management, including AI models as well as data privacy standards and legislation
  • Excellent English and preferably German presentation and writing skills
 

Additional and Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge and experience with dataspaces, ideally within the Common European Data Space initiative
  • Knowledge and experience in software deployment and software lifecycle management (ideally based on principles of continuous integration/continuous deployment, CI/CD)
  • Basic knowledge and practical skills in software design and engineering
  • Basic knowledge and practical skills in IT and cybersecurity for software and software platform development
  • Experience with agile development methods


Conditions:

Working time

full time (40 hrs) / part-time possible

flexible working model with electronic time recording

Contract duration

title: Senior Rollout Manager (f/m/x) – DACH
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at IONITY GmbH
description_html:
Your mission

IONITY baut ein europaweites Netzwerk von High-Power-Ladestationen auf und betreibt dieses. Als Senior Rollout Manager übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung mehrerer Ladestandorte in der DACH-Region – von der Rollout-Planung und der Standortvorbereitung über die Bauphase, Inbetriebnahme und Abnahme bis zur Übergabe an Operations. Du überführst komplexe, funktionsübergreifende Projekte in einen planbaren und verlässlichen Rollout neuer Standorte.
Die Rolle verbindet Projektmanagement, Infrastrukturentwicklung und Stakeholder-Management. Du koordinierst interne Teams, Behörden, Grundstückseigentümer, Netzbetreiber, Baufirmen, Installationspartner und spezialisierte Partner auf gemeinsame Meilensteine, Entscheidungen und Qualitätsstandards. Deine Arbeit leistet einen direkten Beitrag zum Wachstum des europäischen IONITY Netzwerks, sowie einem zuverlässigen Ladeerlebnis für Elektrofahrzeugfahrerinnen und -fahrer aus ganz Europa. Jede neue Ladesäule als Ergebnis deiner Arbeit beschleunigt die Verkehrswende und ist ein wichtiger Beitrag für eine emissionsfreie Mobilität.

  • Du übernimmst die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für die Umsetzung eines Portfolios von HPC-Ladestandorten in der DACH-Region, mit besonderem Fokus auf die komplexesten, risikoreichsten oder strategisch wichtigsten Standorte. Über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus hinweg steuerst du Umfang, Zeitplan, Abhängigkeiten, Risikoexponierung, Kostenrisiken, Qualität, Sicherheit, Compliance und die betriebliche Umsetzungsreife.
  • Du übersetzt die Rollout-Ziele in integrierte Standort- und Portfolioumsetzungspläne, definierst Prioritäten, Reihenfolgen, Meilensteine und Abhängigkeiten und stellst eine klare Governance sicher – von der Standortentwicklung und Genehmigungsplanung über die Bauphase und Inbetriebnahme bis zur Übergabe an den Betrieb.
  • Du führst die funktionsübergreifende Umsetzung über die Bereiche Planung und Genehmigung, Bau, Netzanschluss, Logistik etc. hinweg, treibst zeitnahe Entscheidungen voran, löst Konflikte und stellst sicher, dass kritische Schnittstellen zwischen Grundstück, Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Installation der Ladehardware, Prüfung und Inbetriebnahme aktiv gesteuert werden.
  • Du steuerst externe Planungsbüros, Auftragnehmer, Installationsunternehmen und weitere Umsetzungspartner direkt, setzt klare Erwartungen, überwachst die Leistung, steuerst die operative Umsetzung sowie kommerzielle Risiken und stellst sicher, dass die Partner die vereinbarten Ergebnisse liefern.
  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für das Risiko-, Änderungs- und Maßnahmenmanagement des Portfolios, identifizierst kritische Risiken frühzeitig, definierst Gegenmaßnahmen und führst Wiederherstellungspläne für verspätete, blockierte oder erheblich vom Plan abweichende Standorte. Dabei schützt du Umsetzungsqualität, Sicherheit und Compliance.
  • Du triffst Entscheidungen innerhalb deines übertragenen Verantwortungs- und Entscheidungsrahmens und erstellst klare Entscheidungsvorlagen für den Country Manager DACH, sofern eine Eskalation erforderlich ist. Du stellst tragfähige Optionen, Auswirkungen und Empfehlungen dar und wägst dabei Zeitplan, Kosten, Qualität, technische Machbarkeit und die Anforderungen der Stakeholder gegeneinander ab.
  • Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Behörden, Netzbetreibern, Grundstückseigentümern, lokalen Stakeholdern und Umsetzungspartnern auf und pflegst diese, vertrittst IONITY auch in komplexen Gesprächen professionell und löst Genehmigungs-, Netzanschluss-, Grundstücks-, Bau- und sonstige Umsetzungshindernisse pragmatisch.
  • Du erstellst prägnante und entscheidungsorientierte Berichte für Senior Stakeholder, einschließlich Fortschritt, prognostizierter Termine, Prognosesicherheit, wesentlicher Risiken, Kosten- und kommerzieller Risiken, Partnerleistung, Maßnahmen zur Planwiederherstellung sowie der erforderlichen Entscheidungen, um das Portfolio auf Kurs zu halten.
  • Du etablierst und verbesserst kontinuierlich Rollout-Standards, Governance-Routinen, Vorlagen und Umsetzungsleitfäden. Auf Basis gewonnener Erkenntnisse erhöhst du die Planbarkeit, Qualität, Skalierbarkeit und Umsetzungseffektivität des Rollouts im gesamten DACH-Netzwerk.


Your profile

  • Du bist ein Teamplayer und arbeitest auch unter Zeitdruck mit einem hohen Anspruch an Qualität.
  • Du verfügst über nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Leitung der Umsetzung komplexer Infrastruktur-, Bau-, Energie-, Mobilitäts-, Telekommunikations- oder vergleichbarer Rollout-Programme über mehrere Standorte hinweg, ideralerweise im Bereich HPC Ladeinfrastruktur.
  • Du kannst eine Erfolgsbilanz bei der Übernahme von Ergebnisverantwortung über den gesamten Umsetzungslebenszyklus vorweisen – und nicht nur für einzelne Projektaufgaben oder Arbeitspakete.
  • Du verfügst über ausgeprägte Kenntnisse in Programm- und Projektsteuerung, einschließlich integrierter Planung, Risikomanagement, Abhängigkeitsmanagement, Änderungssteuerung und Reporting auf Senior-Ebene.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Partner sowie in der Einflussnahme auf interne Stakeholder in einer Matrixorganisation. Du trittst sicher auf, stellst bestehende Ansätze konstruktiv infrage, triffst Entscheidungen und eskalierst Themen, wenn dies erforderlich ist.
  • Du verfügst über ein fundiertes praktisches Verständnis der Schnittstellen zwischen Standortentwicklung, Genehmigungsplanung, Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe an den Betrieb.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und strukturiert auf Deutsch und Englisch.
  • Du besitzt einen gültigen Führerschein und bist bereit, regelmäßig mit Teams an den Standorten zusammenzuarbeiten.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Ladeinfrastruktur für Elektrofahrzeuge, Anlagen im Bereich erneuerbare Energien oder anderer dezentraler, kundenorientierter Infrastruktur.
  • Du verfügst über etablierte Arbeitsbeziehungen zu Behörden, Netzbetreibern, Grundstückseigentümern und Baupartnern in einem oder mehreren DACH-Märkten.
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Schnittstellen zu Hochspannungs- oder elektrotechnischer Infrastruktur sowie mit der Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe in ein operatives Netzwerk.
  • Du verfügst über gute Anwenderkenntnisse in AutoCAD und Microsoft Office, einschließlich fortgeschrittener Excel-Kenntnisse oder vergleichbarer Projektsteuerungs-Tools.
  • Du hast ein einschlägiges Hochschulstudium, eine technische Qualifikation oder vergleichbare berufliche Erfahrung in den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Bauwesen, Infrastruktur oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet.

title: Senior People Operations & Payroll Manager (f/m/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at IONITY GmbH
description_html:
Your mission

IONITY is building the backbone of electric mobility in Europe. Founded by leading automotive manufacturers, we operate Europe’s largest high-power charging network across 24 countries, enabling seamless long-distance travel for EV drivers. With thousands of charging points already in operation and significant expansion ahead, IONITY is evolving beyond charging infrastructure into a broader mobility, energy and digital platform. 

As Senior People Ops & Payroll Manager, you'll ensure IONITY's People Operations and payroll run accurately, on time and with care across our multi-country European setup. This is a hands-on role for someone who knows payroll inside out, enjoys making processes cleaner and more scalable, and wants the admin side of work to feel effortless for employees. 

You'll own the payroll cycle end to end, keep our employee data and lifecycle processes in great shape, and be the go-to partner for our external payroll providers, People Partners and employees. 

What you'll do 

  • Own the monthly payroll process across countries, including preparatory payroll accounting, inputs, handovers and sign-off with external payroll providers.
  • Keep employee master data in Personio & Deel accurate, compliant and audit-ready.
  • Manage core lifecycle processes (onboarding, leave, offboarding), including work time accounts, eAUadministration and work certificates.
  • Act as a main contact for payroll providers, tax advisors and auditors, and resolve issues quickly and professionally.
  • Spot friction in processes, systems and workflows, then fix it, using automation and exploring AI where they add real value.
  • Support the alignment of employee benefits across countries while respecting local requirements.
  • Partner closely with People Partners and Finance so payroll, reporting and People processes join up.
  • Answer employee questions on pay and HR admin with clarity and discretion.
  • Guide or mentor junior team members, own larger process and system projects, and act as a sparring partner to People leadership.


Your profile

  • 5 years of experience in payroll and People / HR Operations, ideally including German payroll.
  • Experience coordinating payroll across multiple countries, working with external providers. 
  • Strong knowledge of relevant labor law, tax and social security requirements, with a willingness to learn new countries.
  • Hands-on experience with Deel & Personio is a strong plus.
  • A structured, reliable and discreet way of working, with a real eye for detail and deadlines.
  • A pragmatic, improvement-minded approach: you like clean processes, but not bureaucracy for its own sake.
  • Curiosity about how systems, automation and AI can make work better.
  • Fluent English and German; another European language is a bonus.
  • Proven ownership of multi-country payroll and experience leading process or system improvements, or guiding others.

description_html:
Your new team:

As a Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d) at auxmoney, you’ll join our IT Risk & Pricing team, where we build backend systems and services that support risk decisioning, pricing, and data-driven product logic. The work is backend-heavy, involving complex technical problem-solving and close integration with data/analytics workflows. 
 
In this role, you’ll design and deliver impactful features, help evolve a scalable, resilient architecture, and take end-to-end ownership from concept through production. You’ll work closely with analysts/data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders to ship high-quality solutions and continuously improve our engineering standards. If you are passionate about writing clean, maintainable code, solving complex technical challenges, and building software that delivers real value, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.


What you can expect:

  • Architecture & System Design: Identify and address architectural limitations, make pragmatic trade-offs, and help evolve systems toward scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Technical Leadership: Act as a trusted technical expert by promoting engineering best practices, facilitating technical discussions, and helping teams align on high-quality solutions.
  • Engineering Quality: Build solutions that are secure, scalable, extensible, and cost-efficient while maintaining high coding and documentation standards.
  • Execution & Delivery: Break down complex initiatives into manageable workstreams and deliver incremental value through iterative development.
  • Impact & Knowledge Sharing: Champion engineering excellence, share knowledge proactively, and support the professional growth of colleagues.
  • Collaboration & Problem Solving: Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders, actively contribute to design reviews, and address root causes of recurring technical challenges.
  • Ownership & Mentorship: Take responsibility for challenging projects and guide team members through technical mentoring and hands-on support.
  • Strategic Thinking & Growth Mindset: Balance short-term delivery with long-term system sustainability and continuously look for opportunities to improve technology, processes, and team effectiveness.


Your profile

  • Backend Engineering Expertise: Several years of hands-on backend development experience with preferably strong proficiency in PHP, particularly using the Symfony framework and Python.
  • System & API Development: Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust backend systems in production environments, including strong expertise in developing and integrating RESTful APIs.
  • SQL Expertise: Hands-on SQL experience in application development, with strong proficiency in relational data modelling (table design, keys, and constraints) and writing complex, performant queries to support business features.
  • Cloud & DevOps Practices: Experience working with cloud platforms (preferably AWS) and modern DevOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure automation. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes is highly valued.
  • Event-Driven Architecture (Bonus): Familiarity with Kafka or similar event-driven messaging systems is considered a strong advantage.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Solid understanding of automated testing strategies, including unit and integration testing, with a focus on delivering reliable and high-quality software aligned with overall quality standards.
  • Product-Oriented Mindset: A strong focus on building solutions that deliver measurable value for users and business outcomes.
  • Team & Communication Skills: Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and contribute to a supportive engineering culture.
  • Security & Compliance Awareness: A proactive approach to implementing security best practices and ensuring compliance throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Language Skills: Fluent written and spoken English.


What we offer:

  • Flexibility for Your Lifestyle: Enjoy family-friendly working hours and a generous home office policy, allowing you to stay agile and flexible in any situation.
  • Ergonomic Work Environment: For your office days, we provide ergonomic workstations that offer you a comfortable and healthy workspace.
  • Independent Work: With short decision-making paths, we enable you to work autonomously and actively contribute your ideas – we provide space for you to take on responsibility.

  • Mobility Your Way: Whether you prefer a train ticket or parking – we support your choice of preferred mobility.
  • Stay Active: Keep fit with a discounted membership at Fitness First or Urban Sports Club, or use our in-house fitness room to stay active after work and enhance your work-life balance.
  • Secure Your Future: Think about your future – we offer subsidies for company pension plans so you can plan long-term with us.
  • Tailored Benefits: We consider your personal life situation – whether you're a parent or love to travel, we offer customized benefits to suit your lifestyle.

For us as an employer, equal opportunities and diversity are especially important. Therefore, we welcome applications from mothers, fathers, people with disabilities and people from the LGBTQIA+ community. Please feel free to let us know if, for example, you would like us to use a gender-neutral pronoun, if you need barrier-free access to our office, or if you would like us to allow more time for the application process.

title: Training Specialist (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at DocuWare
description_html:
Why should you join?

DocuWare stands for globally distributed, international teams and an open corporate culture that invites you to help shape it. Mobile Work and flexible working hours are part of our everyday life. Would you like to be part of an innovative company whose solutions are digitizing everyday work in a wide range of industries? In that case, we are happy to welcome you to the team.


Your Responsibilities

As a Training Specialist (m/f/d), you will empower our sales teams and partners to successfully sell, confidently demonstrate, and effectively implement DocuWare solutions for our customers. Leveraging your expertise, you will develop modern learning programs, deliver engaging training experiences, and play a key role in strengthening the success of our sales and partner organizations.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • You plan, coordinate, and deliver training programs for our sales teams and partners, ensuring an engaging and effective learning experience.
  • You design modern training concepts and define appropriate methodologies and instructional approaches to enable sustainable knowledge transfer.
  • You create, update, and continuously improve training programs based on business requirements and learning objectives.
  • You develop and maintain high-quality training materials, including course content, e-learning modules, assessments, and certification programs.
  • You collaborate closely with sales teams, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to align training content with business needs and audience expectations.
  • You support the creation, maintenance, and enhancement of product demonstrations for our sales teams and partners.
  • You act as a subject matter expert in meetings, workshops, and events, providing guidance on sales and product-related topics.
  • You identify opportunities to improve existing training offerings and actively contribute new ideas to enhance our learning and enablement programs.


What you need to succeed

  • You hold a degree in Education, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, or have gained equivalent qualifications through relevant professional experience.
  • You are skilled at adapting to different audiences and levels of expertise, delivering content in a clear, practical, and impactful way.
  • You have ideally gained experience in training, enablement, learning & development, or technical support.
  • You are proficient in Microsoft Office, CRM systems, and modern presentation and collaboration tools, and you are confident delivering both in-person and virtual training sessions.
  • You have a solid understanding of the customer journey, sales processes, and common sales methodologies such as SPIN.
  • You possess a strong understanding of business processes and their translation into digital workflows, and you can quickly familiarize yourself with complex software solutions.
  • Experience with DocuWare or other document management solutions is an advantage.
  • You are fluent in both German and English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • You work independently, thrive in international team environments, and bring strong communication, networking, and interpersonal skills.


What we can offer

There are many great reasons to join DocuWare - our company culture is only one of them.
 As part of the DocuWare team, you will benefit from many advantages:

  • Globally distributed, international teams: You will find our teams working in Germering, New York, Sofia or other worldwide locations.
  • Flexible work location and hours: You work hybrid - on the road or in our modern office - and you have the flexibility to arrange your own working hours.
  • Individual support: After an intensive induction, you will receive regular training tailored to your needs (e.g. conferences internal team building measures).
  • Well-earned rest: 35 vacation days per year, sport offerings, massages, a football table and a relaxing lounge area.
  • Mental health support: With our employee assistance program you have free and confidential access to resources and support for your well-being and stress management at any time.
  • Healthy food: Together we enjoy Fairtrade coffee with organic milk or oat milk, snacks and fresh fruit - all free of charge - as well as subsidized lunch from the Foodji fridge.
  • Free Tuesday Lunch: Every Tuesday, enjoy a complimentary and varied lunch.
  • Good accessibility: Choose how you would like to come to the office with a leased e-bike, by train or via highways A96/A99 (you can charge your e-car on site for free).
  • Team spirit: Regular employee and team events (virtual or on-site) ensure excellent collaboration with colleagues around the world.
  • Sustainability and social commitment: DocuWare stands for paperless work and supports volunteer organizations and local sports clubs.
  • Planning for your future: DocuWare subsidizes your company pension plan!
  • We offer a stable job with a well established and growing company.
  • Unique benefits: Choose one of three great options (Bonago, E-Gym or subsidized Deutschlandticket) to suit your needs.
  • We only use the latest technologies - find out more on Stackshare.
  • Up to 30 Days Work from Abroad: Experience international opportunities and broaden your horizons.
  • Family First: Preferential registration in our selected daycare center in Germering (no guarantee).
  • Buddy Program: You'll be paired with a buddy, who will support you during your onboarding and offer valuable tips.
For better insights, check us out on Instagram!

  • You adapt content and flow to address specific use cases and stakeholder concerns.

Technical validation

  • You plan and support proofs of concept for strategic pursuits, defining scope, success metrics, and timelines.
  • You handle in-depth technical questions throughout the sales cycle and coordinate SME input where needed.
  • You contribute to high-quality responses for RFPs and technical questionnaires.
  • You assess feasibility against customer requirements and propose workable alternatives.

Opportunity collaboration

  • You partner with Sales Directors and Partner Managers to shape strategy, next steps, and executive alignment.
  • You share structured feedback on recurring requirements and objections to refine positioning.
  • You provide insights that strengthen competitive differentiation and the overall solution narrative.
  • You ensure a smooth handover to Professional Services with clear scope, assumptions, and identified risks.
  • You mentor more junior Presales Consultants on complex opportunities, sharing best practices and review support.


What you need to succeed

  • You have proven experience supporting complex sales opportunities in a presales, solution consulting, or technical customer-facing role; this is a must-have.
  • You bring several years of successful experience in solution selling, presales, or professional services, ideally in software or SaaS.
  • You demonstrate a strong technical grasp of software solutions, system integrations, workflows, APIs, cloud technologies, and business applications.
  • You analyze customer business processes and translate them into clear technical and solution concepts.
  • You plan and deliver product demonstrations, proofs of concept, and technical workshops that drive measurable outcomes.
  • You are hands-on with technology, possess strong computer skills, and confidently demonstrate software to diverse audiences.
  • You collaborate effectively with Sales, Professional Services, and technical implementation teams to keep opportunities moving.
  • You combine entrepreneurial thinking with a strong, customer-centric mindset.
  • You communicate fluently in English (spoken and written); German fluency is a plus.


What we can offer

What we can offer:

There are many great reasons to join DocuWare - our company culture is only one of them.
 As part of the DocuWare team, you will benefit from many advantages:

  • Globally distributed, international teams: You will find our teams working in Germering, New York, Sofia or other worldwide locations.
